context.description_en: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
context.description_zh: 每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。
context.name: antimage_mana_break
notes_en: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
notes_zh: 幻象继承法力损毁的燃烧魔法为%illusion_percentage%%%。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。

context.description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
context.description_zh: 短距离传送，能让敌法师自由出入战场。
context.name: antimage_blink
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。

scepter_loc.en: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.
scepter_loc.zh: 施放闪烁后，%empowered_mana_break_duration%秒内的法力损毁将额外燃烧%empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%%最大魔法值，并且阻止目标在短时间内恢复或获得魔法。这个负面状态无法驱散。

context.description_en: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
context.description_zh: 被动提升魔法抗性。可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。
facet_text_en: Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.
facet_text_zh: 法术反制会使施法者被燃烧该技能魔法消耗的一定百分比，并且造成%damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%%燃烧魔法的伤害，最高为每次反弹技能造成%max_damage_from_mana_drain%点伤害。
context.name: antimage_counterspell
notes_en: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动魔法抗性失效。

shard_loc.en: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
shard_loc.zh: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。

context.description_en: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
context.description_zh: 攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。%mana_threshold%%%魔法时造成最低减速，0%%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于%mana_threshold%%%魔法时没有效果。
context.name: antimage_persectur
notes_en: Full effect if caused by illusions.
notes_zh: 幻象造成全额效果。

context.description_en: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
context.description_zh: 根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂眩晕。
facet_text_en:
Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.
facet_text_zh:
敌方英雄的魔法值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%时会被动提供攻击力，而且魔法值越低，提升效果越大。

如果敌人的魔法值低于%threshold_pct%%%，敌法师获得攻击力加成的最大值，以及该英雄的视野和真实视域。会施加给%thirst_range%范围内的敌方英雄。每个英雄提供的加成效果可以叠加。
context.name: antimage_mana_void
notes_en: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
notes_zh: 伤害的计算根据主目标失去的魔法，但是对作用范围内所有敌人均有效。

context.description_en: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
context.description_zh: 斧王嘲讽附近的敌方单位，强迫他们攻击自己，同时获得额外护甲。
facet_text_en: Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.
facet_text_zh: 狂战士之吼提供的护甲更高，而且增加了受作用单位的攻击速度。
context.name: axe_berserkers_call

shard_loc.en: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
shard_loc.zh: 狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。

context.description_en: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
context.description_zh: 激怒一个敌方单位，使他受到持续伤害，直到他杀死一个单位或者持续时间结束。敌人只要背朝斧王还将被减速。
context.name: axe_battle_hunger
notes_en: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
notes_zh: 摧毁建筑也能移除该状态效果。

shard_loc.en: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
shard_loc.zh: 多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。

context.description_en: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
context.description_zh: 受到一定次数攻击后，斧王就会做出螺旋反击，对附近所有敌方单位造成纯粹伤害。
context.name: axe_counter_helix
notes_en: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
notes_zh: 反击螺旋会在斧王受到攻击时触发。
拥有神杖后自身幻象的攻击不会计入触发计数。

scepter_loc.en: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。

context.description_en:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
context.description_zh:
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。

每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
context.name: axe_culling_blade
notes_en: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.
notes_zh: 淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。

context.description_en: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.
context.description_zh: 只要斧王附近%radius%范围内没有友方英雄，他就会获得%armor_pct_as_strength%%%自身护甲值的力量加成。这个效果在接近一名友军后会在%bonus_linger_duration%秒内消失。
context.name: axe_one_man_army

context.description_en: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
context.description_zh: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。
context.name: bane_enfeeble

context.description_en: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。
context.name: bane_brain_sap

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成%shard_radius%作用范围的技能。次级目标只有%shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%治疗效果。

context.description_en: Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely. Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
context.description_zh: 让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
facet_text_en: Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.
facet_text_zh: 祸乱之源在攻击噩梦中单位时获得额外的攻击速度。
噩梦中单位会朝选定方向走去。
context.name: bane_nightmare
notes_en: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
notes_zh: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每%fiend_grip_tick_interval%秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。
context.name: bane_fiends_grip

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.
scepter_loc.zh: 魔爪的冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受%scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

context.description_en: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.
context.description_zh: 每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的状态抗性减少。
context.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha

context.description_en: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
context.description_zh: 使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
context.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
notes_en: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
notes_zh: 对血魔造成的伤害不致死。

shard_loc.en: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as Pure damage.
shard_loc.zh: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成%max_health_dmg_pct%%%目标最大生命值的纯粹伤害。

context.description_en: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
context.description_zh: 血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。%delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip%秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被沉默。
context.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
notes_en: Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.
notes_zh: 总时间为%delay%秒的施法时间加上%castpoint_tooltip%秒的生效延迟。

context.description_en: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
context.description_zh: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于%invis_threshold_pct%%%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
facet_text_en: Can be activated to grant bonus movement speed and %sanguivore_multiplier%x Sanguivore heal bonus for a short duration. While on cooldown, passive Thirst move speed is reduced by %inactive_penalty_pct%%% . Cannot be cast when all enemy heroes are at full health.
facet_text_zh: 可以主动开启，短时间内获得移动速度加成和%sanguivore_multiplier%倍食血动物治疗加成。技能冷却时焦渴的被动移速加成减少%inactive_penalty_pct%%%。无法在所有敌方英雄满血时施放。
context.name: bloodseeker_thirst
notes_en: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.
notes_zh: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于%max_bonus_pct%%%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续%linger_duration%秒。

context.description_en: Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
context.description_zh: 血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础%base_heal%点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
context.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
notes_en: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%.
notes_zh: 非英雄单位的吸血效果减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
context.description_zh: 让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
context.name: bloodseeker_rupture

scepter_loc.en: Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升初始伤害，并且提供%AbilityCharges%点割裂能量点数。

context.description_en: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
context.description_zh: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
facet_text_en: Crystal Nova has increased radius and grants allied heroes a physical damage barrier. Barrier is increased for Crystal Maiden.
facet_text_zh: 冰霜新星拥有更大的作用范围，并且为友方英雄提供一个物理伤害护盾。水晶室女身上的护盾数值更高。
context.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
notes_en: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
notes_zh: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。

context.description_en: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.
context.description_zh: 操控冰霜包围一个敌方单位，禁止移动和攻击，并持续造成伤害。对非远古的普通单位施放将造成%creep_multiplier%倍伤害。
context.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
notes_en: Frostbite is considered a root.
notes_zh: 冰封禁制为捆缚效果。

context.description_en: Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
context.description_zh: 地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近%proximity_bonus_radius%范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。
facet_text_en: Activating Arcane Aura temporarily increases Crystal Maiden's spell amplification and mana costs. During the duration, Crystal Maiden restores her own and her allies' Mana when casting spells. Does not affect items. Duration is paused while channeling Freezing Field.
facet_text_zh: 主动开启奥术光环会临时提升水晶室女的技能增强，但技能的魔法消耗也会增加。在持续时间内，只要水晶室女施放技能，她和她的友军都会回复魔法。不会影响物品。极寒领域的持续施法期间持续时间会暂停。
context.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura

context.description_en: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
context.description_zh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近%frostbite_radius%范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。
context.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone

context.description_en: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.
context.description_zh: 水晶室女消耗在她技能上的一部分魔法会转化为物理护盾。
context.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤%num_explosions%次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。
context.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
notes_en: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
Explosions occur every %explosion_interval_tooltip% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续%slow_duration%秒）。
每%explosion_interval_tooltip%秒产生一次爆炸。

scepter_loc.en: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

context.description_en: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
context.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
notes_en: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
notes_zh: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。

scepter_loc.en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
scepter_loc.zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

context.description_en: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
context.description_zh: 释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。
context.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
context.name: drow_ranger_multishot
notes_en: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.
notes_zh: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

context.description_en: Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
context.name: drow_ranger_glacier

context.description_en: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠根据她自身的当前敏捷和英雄等级获得敏捷加成。附近远程英雄获得%trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%%敏捷加成。
context.name: drow_ranger_trueshot

context.description_en: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果%disable_range%范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
context.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
notes_en: Marksmanship procs have true strike.
notes_zh: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。

context.description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
context.description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
facet_text_en: Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.
facet_text_zh: 被沟壑击中的敌方英雄会对%echoes_radius%范围内附近每个单位释放一道回音，造成的伤害等同于回音击的%echoes_damage_multiplier%%%当前回音伤害。
context.name: earthshaker_fissure
notes_en: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。

shard_loc.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
shard_loc.zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

context.description_en: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
context.description_zh: 强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和%bonus_attack_range%攻击距离加成。
context.name: earthshaker_enchant_totem
notes_en: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。

scepter_loc.en: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
scepter_loc.zh: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。

context.description_en: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
context.description_zh: 撼地者施放技能时会引起脚下的大地震动，眩晕附近的敌方单位并造成额外伤害。
context.name: earthshaker_aftershock
notes_en: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发余震。

context.description_en: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
context.description_zh: 穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。
context.name: earthshaker_echo_slam

context.description_en: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.
context.description_zh: 利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。
context.name: earthshaker_slugger

special_values.heading_loc: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE:
special_values.name: projectile_body_damage_additional_percent_health

context.description_en: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
context.description_zh: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%，并且每%blade_fury_damage_tick%秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。
context.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
notes_en: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
notes_zh: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect. Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升作用范围并减速范围内的敌人。主宰每%attack_interval%秒对作用的敌人发动一次攻击。

context.description_en: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例治疗他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为%healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip%。持续%abilityduration%秒。
context.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
notes_en: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
notes_zh: 可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。

shard_loc.en: Increases ward healing and health.
shard_loc.zh: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

context.description_en: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
context.description_zh: 主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。
context.name: juggernaut_blade_dance

context.description_en: Performs a short Omnislash for %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 发动一次短时间的无敌斩，持续%duration%秒。
context.name: juggernaut_swift_slash

context.description_en: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
context.description_zh: 主宰未受到伤害时每%stack_gain_time%秒获得一层剑心的叠加层数。每层叠加效果提供基础敏捷和移动速度加成。叠加效果在受到任何伤害时会粘滞%linger_duration%秒后再消失。
context.name: juggernaut_bladeform
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

context.description_en:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
notes_en: You can use items during Omnislash.
notes_zh: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

context.description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
context.description_zh: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。%starfall_secondary_radius%范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
facet_text_en: Starstorm's second meteor deals more damage and blinds the target.
facet_text_zh: 群星风暴的第二颗流星会造成更多伤害，并具有致盲效果。
context.name: mirana_starfall
notes_en: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
notes_zh: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。

context.description_en: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
context.description_zh: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
context.name: mirana_arrow
notes_en: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
notes_zh: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
scepter_loc.zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

context.description_en: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续%leap_bonus_duration%秒。
facet_text_en: Upon landing, Leap roots targets in a %root_radius% radius for %root_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 落地时跳跃会缠绕米拉娜附近%root_radius%范围内的目标，持续%root_duration%秒。
context.name: mirana_leap

shard_loc.en: Grants +%additional_charges% Leap charge.
shard_loc.zh: 获得+%additional_charges%跳跃能量点数。

context.description_en: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
context.description_zh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。
context.name: mirana_celestial_quiver

shard_loc.en: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.
shard_loc.zh: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得%quiver_restore%点临时能量。

context.description_en: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
context.description_zh: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。
context.name: mirana_invis
notes_en: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
context.description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
facet_text_en: Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
facet_text_zh: 对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。
context.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
notes_en: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。

shard_loc.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

context.description_en:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
context.description_zh:
影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续%duration%秒。在持续时间内，每%soul_collection_interval%秒他从%soul_collection_radius%范围内的%soul_collection_per_interval%个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留%linger_duration%秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。

从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。
context.name: nevermore_frenzy

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
context.description_zh: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
facet_text_en: Presence of the Dark Lord temporarily reduces more armor after nearby enemy heroes are killed.
facet_text_zh: 在附近敌方英雄阵亡后魔王降临的降低护甲效果将会暂时提升。
context.name: nevermore_dark_lord
notes_en: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
notes_zh: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
context.description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
context.name: nevermore_requiem
notes_en: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
context.description_zh: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
facet_text_en: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.
facet_text_zh: 每次击杀英雄会使灵魂上限增加%max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill%个，直到影魔阵亡。
context.name: nevermore_necromastery
notes_en: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

scepter_loc.en: Increases max souls.
scepter_loc.zh: 提高灵魂数量上限。

context.description_en: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
context.description_zh: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。
facet_text_en: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.
facet_text_zh: 波浪形态会攻击路径上的敌人。不会施加攻击特效。
context.name: morphling_waveform

context.description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
context.description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
facet_text_en: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.
facet_text_zh: 变体打击会根据变体精灵的力量值造成眩晕。
context.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
notes_en: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。

context.description_en: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
context.description_zh: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
context.name: morphling_morph_agi
notes_en: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
notes_zh: 属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。

shard_loc.en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard_loc.zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

context.description_en: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
context.description_zh: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些敏捷以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成力量。该过程可逆。
context.name: morphling_morph_str
notes_en: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
notes_zh: 属性变换不能转换物品提供的属性加成。
升级力量获取时也会升级敏捷获取。

shard_loc.en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard_loc.zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

context.description_en: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
context.description_zh: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标改变自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
context.name: morphling_replicate
notes_en: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
scepter_loc.zh: 变形增加多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

context.description_en: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
context.description_zh: 变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和减速抗性，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
context.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
notes_en: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.
notes_zh: 变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。

context.description_en: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
context.description_zh: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
facet_text_en: Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.
facet_text_zh: 幻影长矛手幻象放出的灵魂之矛会造成%illusion_lance_damage_pct%%%长矛伤害。
context.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
notes_en: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
notes_zh: 幻影长矛手附近%fake_lance_distance%范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。

scepter_loc.en: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。

context.description_en:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.
facet_text_zh: 幻影长矛手每缺失%hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%%生命都会额外产生一个幻象。
context.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
notes_en: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
notes_zh: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。

context.description_en: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
context.description_zh: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
context.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
notes_en: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.
notes_zh: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

context.description_en: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续%duration%秒。
context.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments

context.description_en: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
facet_text_en: Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.
facet_text_zh: 并列的幻象会在附近随机单位身旁产生，继承更高的攻击力，但是无法控制。
context.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose

shard_loc.en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
shard_loc.zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。

context.description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt. Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
context.description_zh:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。

在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
context.name: puck_illusory_orb
notes_en: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.
notes_zh: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

context.description_en: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
context.description_zh: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。
facet_text_en: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.
facet_text_zh: 新月之痕会把敌人推开。如果技能设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把他们拉近。
context.name: puck_waning_rift

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
context.name: puck_phase_shift
notes_en: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
notes_zh: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。

shard_loc.en: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
shard_loc.zh: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

context.description_en: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.
context.description_zh: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的%mana_and_health_restore_pct%%%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复%dodged_spell_multiplier%倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。
context.name: puck_puckish

context.description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
context.description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。
context.name: puck_dream_coil

scepter_loc.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_loc.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

context.description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
context.description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
facet_text_en: Meat Hook deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled, but base damage is reduced.
facet_text_zh: 肉钩会根据牵引的距离造成额外伤害，但基础伤害减少。
context.name: pudge_meat_hook
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。

shard_loc.en: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。

context.description_en: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
context.description_zh: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
context.name: pudge_rot
notes_en: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
notes_zh: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。

context.description_en: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
context.description_zh: 帕吉用一层血肉包裹自己，可以格挡所有来源的所有类型伤害。
context.name: pudge_flesh_heap

context.description_en: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining %flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount% bonus Strength for each stack.
context.description_zh: 每次帕吉击杀敌方英雄时，他的皮肤就会永久变厚，获得的每层叠加效果为%flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount%点额外力量。
context.name: pudge_innate_graft_flesh
notes_en: Enemy Heroes that die within %flesh_heap_range% of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.
notes_zh: 帕吉附近%flesh_heap_range%范围内敌方英雄阵亡时他都会获得一层叠加效果，不论击杀者是谁。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒%pull_units_per_second%的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引%pull_distance_limit%距离。
facet_text_en: Dismember increases Strength when dealing damage to heroes.
facet_text_zh: 肢解每次对英雄造成伤害时都会提升自身力量值。
context.name: pudge_dismember
notes_en: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
notes_zh: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。

context.description_en: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
context.description_zh: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。
context.name: razor_plasma_field

context.description_en: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
context.description_zh: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
context.name: razor_static_link
notes_en: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.
notes_zh: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过%drain_range_buffer%后断裂。

shard_loc.en: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.
shard_loc.zh: 提升施法距离。减缓目标的移动速度，数值为连接生效时%move_speed_factor%倍的攻击力窃取量。

context.description_en: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
context.description_zh: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
context.name: razor_storm_surge
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

shard_loc.en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

context.description_en: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.
context.description_zh: 被动提升雷泽的移动速度。
context.name: razor_unstable_current

context.description_en: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
context.description_zh: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。
context.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
notes_en: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
notes_zh: 每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。
风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
scepter_loc.zh: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

context.description_en: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
context.description_zh: 沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
context.name: sandking_burrowstrike
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
context.description_zh: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得隐身效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
facet_text_en: Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.
facet_text_zh: 沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。
context.name: sandking_sand_storm
notes_en: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
notes_zh: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。

context.description_en: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
context.description_zh: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
context.name: sandking_scorpion_strike

shard_loc.en: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.
shard_loc.zh: 被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

context.description_en: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
context.description_zh: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。
context.name: sandking_caustic_finale

context.description_en: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
context.description_zh: 经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
context.name: sandking_epicenter
notes_en: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
notes_zh: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。

scepter_loc.en: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
scepter_loc.zh: 地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

shard_loc.en: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
shard_loc.zh: 每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。

context.description_en: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for %abilityduration% seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
context.description_zh: 风暴之灵制造一个充满爆炸性能量的自身残影，会向目标地点走去，持续%abilityduration%秒。如果有人接近就会引爆造成伤害，残影持续%abilityduration%秒。
context.name: storm_spirit_static_remnant
notes_en: Remnants take %static_remnant_delay% second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a %static_remnant_damage_radius% radius, but will only be triggered in %static_remnant_radius%.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.
notes_zh: 残影在技能施放%static_remnant_delay%秒后才能实体化。
残影在持续时间内拥有顺畅视野。
残影爆炸将伤害%static_remnant_damage_radius%码作用范围内的单位，但是触发范围是%static_remnant_radius%码。
可以对自身施放，这样会原地施放。

context.description_en: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
context.description_zh: 将一个敌人拖到风暴之灵所在位置的涡流。
facet_text_en: Electric Vortex applies a debuff to the enemy that lasts for %enemy_overload_duration%s making their next attack target themself and trigger an Overload Charge.
facet_text_zh: 电子涡流会对敌人施加%enemy_overload_duration%秒的负面效果，使敌人下次攻击会以自身为目标，并触发一次超负荷。
context.name: storm_spirit_electric_vortex

scepter_loc.en: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
scepter_loc.zh: 电子涡流变成范围型技能，可以作用于风暴之灵周围所有敌人。

context.description_en: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
context.description_zh: 施法时会产生电荷，在风暴之灵下次攻击时被释放，对附近敌人造成伤害并减速。
context.name: storm_spirit_overload
notes_en: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发超负荷。
超负荷效果不会叠加。

shard_loc.en: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.
shard_loc.zh: 施放后风暴之灵和附近友方英雄获得%shard_activation_charges%次超负荷效果。提供额外攻击速度。持续最多%shard_activation_duration%秒，或效果用尽。

context.description_en: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
context.description_zh: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
context.name: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
notes_en: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.
notes_zh: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

context.description_en: Storm Spirit gains a charge of %mp_per_kill% mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every %level_divisor% levels. Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains %perma_mp_per_kill% Mana Regen permanently.
context.description_zh: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供%mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每%level_divisor%级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失%charges_per_death%点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得%perma_mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复。
context.name: storm_spirit_galvanized
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法通过击杀获得新的叠加效果。

context.description_en: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
context.description_zh: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和眩晕。
context.name: sven_storm_bolt

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

context.description_en: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
context.description_zh: 斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。
context.name: sven_great_cleave

context.description_en: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 斯温的战吼激励着同伴作战，提升他们的护甲和移动速度。持续%duration%秒。
context.name: sven_warcry

shard_loc.en: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.
shard_loc.zh: 提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供%base_barrier_amount%点物理伤害护盾。

context.description_en: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 斯温爆发出他流浪剑客的力量，获得攻击力加成和减速抗性，持续%abilityduration%秒。
context.name: sven_gods_strength
notes_en: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.
notes_zh: 额外攻击力是基于斯温的基础攻击力和主属性数值。

context.description_en: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.
context.description_zh: 斯温从力量中获得额外攻击力。
context.name: sven_wrath_of_god

context.description_en: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
context.description_zh: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。
context.name: tiny_avalanche

context.description_en: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
context.description_zh: 抓起小小身旁%grab_radius%范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
context.name: tiny_toss
notes_en: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is %duration%s.
notes_zh: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
飞行时间是%duration%秒。

context.description_en: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
context.description_zh: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
context.name: tiny_tree_grab
notes_en: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.
notes_zh: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。
context.name: tiny_tree_channel

context.description_en: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
context.description_zh: 小小从力量中获得状态和减速抗性。减速抗性还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
context.name: tiny_insurmountable
notes_en: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.
notes_zh: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。

context.description_en: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
context.description_zh: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
context.name: tiny_grow

shard_loc.en: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.
shard_loc.zh: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

context.description_en: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
context.description_zh: 将树木扔向目标单位，触发自身对其的攻击，并且对周围目标造成溅射伤害。
context.name: tiny_toss_tree

context.description_en: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，眩晕并造成伤害。
facet_text_en: Magic Missile deals %damage_per_lasthit% bonus damage for every creep the enemy has killed.
facet_text_zh: 魔法箭造成额外伤害，敌人每击杀一个非英雄单位为%damage_per_lasthit%点额外伤害。
context.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile

shard_loc.en: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
shard_loc.zh: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。

context.description_en: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
context.description_zh: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。
context.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror

context.description_en: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
context.description_zh: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。
context.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
notes_en: Break disables the damage aura.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。

scepter_loc.en: Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

context.description_en: Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.
context.description_zh: 复仇之魂的攻击同时被视为远程和近战，可以获得相应加成。只要敌方英雄击杀了复仇之魂，他们会获得一个负面效果，直到下次阵亡，期间复仇之魂会对他们造成%bonus_damage%%%额外伤害。同一时间只能存在一个负面效果。
context.name: vengefulspirit_retribution

context.description_en: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
context.description_zh: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
context.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
notes_en: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

context.description_en: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
context.description_zh: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
facet_text_en: Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.
facet_text_zh: 束缚击会对目标单位身后的所有单位和树木施加，每个额外束缚的单位和树木都会使风行者获得攻击力加成。非英雄单位和树木提供的攻击力加成较少。
context.name: windrunner_shackleshot
notes_en: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
notes_zh: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
facet_text_en: Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.
facet_text_zh: 被击中的敌方英雄血量低于临界值就会被秒杀。秒杀血量是基于箭矢的威力。
context.name: windrunner_powershot
notes_en: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
context.description_zh: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。
context.name: windrunner_windrun

context.description_en: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
context.description_zh: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。
context.name: windrunner_gale_force

context.description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
context.description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
facet_text_en: Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.
facet_text_zh: 集中火力不再需要施法目标，而是对风行者攻击距离 + %bonus_range%范围内的随机敌人发动攻击。每秒发动固定次数的攻击，并且每4箭才会击中一次同个敌人。以英雄优先。
context.name: windrunner_focusfire
notes_en: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

context.description_en:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
context.description_zh:
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。

被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
context.name: windrunner_tailwind

scepter_loc.en: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
scepter_loc.zh: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

context.description_en: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
context.description_zh: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
context.name: zuus_arc_lightning

context.description_en: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
context.description_zh: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
context.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
notes_en: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.
notes_zh: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

context.description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
context.description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
context.name: zuus_heavenly_jump

context.description_en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
context.description_zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
context.name: zuus_cloud
notes_en: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.
notes_zh: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。

context.description_en: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
context.description_zh: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。
context.name: zuus_lightning_hands

context.description_en: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
context.description_zh: 用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
facet_text_en: Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.
facet_text_zh: 从最低生命值的英雄开始，逐一对敌人造成伤害，最后是生命值最高的敌人。如果有敌人被这个技能击杀，那么接下来所有敌人受到的伤害都会增加。
context.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath

context.description_en: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
context.description_zh: 宙斯攻击或通过技能击中敌人都会电击他们，造成他们当前生命值一定百分比的伤害。
facet_text_en: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.
facet_text_zh: 静电场对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。
context.name: zuus_static_field

context.description_en: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
context.description_zh: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、眩晕和减速。
context.name: kunkka_torrent
notes_en: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
notes_zh: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。

context.description_en: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
context.description_zh: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
facet_text_en: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.
facet_text_zh: 潮汐使者每击中一名英雄，冷却时间都会减少。
context.name: kunkka_tidebringer

context.description_en: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
context.description_zh: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
facet_text_en: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.
facet_text_zh: X标记送回目标后，昆卡和回归点附近友军都会获得幽灵船的统帅朗姆酒效果。
context.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot

context.description_en: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于%damage_threshold%%%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的%ghostship_absorb%%%伤害，持续%buff_duration%秒。
context.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
notes_en: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.
notes_zh: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。

context.description_en: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
context.description_zh: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。
context.name: kunkka_tidal_wave

context.description_en: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
context.description_zh: 召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
context.name: kunkka_ghostship
notes_en: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.
notes_zh: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为%ghostship_speed%。

scepter_loc.en: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。

context.description_en: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
context.description_zh: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
context.name: lina_dragon_slave
notes_en: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
context.description_zh: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。
context.name: lina_light_strike_array
notes_en: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续%fiery_soul_stack_duration%秒。
context.name: lina_fiery_soul
notes_en: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.
notes_zh: 每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。

context.description_en: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
context.description_zh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。
context.name: lina_flame_cloak

context.description_en: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 莉娜的技能会在%burn_duration%秒内额外造成%burn_damage_pct%%%原伤害的烧灼伤害。
context.name: lina_slow_burn

context.description_en: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
context.description_zh: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
facet_text_en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
facet_text_zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。
context.name: lina_laguna_blade
notes_en: Laguna Blade has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
notes_zh: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。

shard_loc.en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
shard_loc.zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

context.description_en: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
context.description_zh: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
context.name: lich_frost_nova

context.description_en: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
context.description_zh: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每%interval%秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
facet_text_en: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.
facet_text_zh: 每当敌人死于冰霜魔盾的效果下，技能的持续时间都会增加。
context.name: lich_frost_shield
notes_en: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
notes_zh: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
context.name: lich_sinister_gaze

scepter_loc.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
scepter_loc.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

context.description_en: Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
context.description_zh: 在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受%max_hero_attacks%次英雄攻击或%max_creep_attacks%次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。
context.name: lich_ice_spire

context.description_en: Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
context.description_zh: 牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
context.name: lich_death_charge
notes_en: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.
notes_zh: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

context.description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
context.description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
facet_text_en: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.
facet_text_zh: 连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻击杀敌人后会增加弹跳次数。
context.name: lich_chain_frost
notes_en: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
