Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

context.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
context.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
context.name: lion_impale
notes_en: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
context.description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
context.name: lion_voodoo
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
notes_zh: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
facet_text_en: Mana Drain deals damage equal to %damage_pct%%% of mana stolen.
facet_text_zh: 法力吸取会造成%damage_pct%%%吸魔量的伤害。
context.name: lion_mana_drain
notes_en: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。

shard_loc.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
shard_loc.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

context.description_en: Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.
context.description_zh: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供%debuff_amp%%%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续%duration%秒的%spell_amp%%%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。
context.name: lion_to_hell_and_back

context.description_en: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
context.description_zh: 撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为%punch_attack_range%，并拥有移动速度加成。每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
context.name: lion_finger_of_death
notes_en: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
notes_zh: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后%grace_period%秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

context.description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
context.description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
context.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
notes_en: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

context.description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
context.description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
context.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
notes_zh: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
context.name: shadow_shaman_shackles

scepter_loc.en: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

context.description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
context.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

shard_loc.en: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
shard_loc.zh: 伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。

context.description_en: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的%megaward_multiplier_tooltip%倍，持续%ward_duration%秒。
context.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda

context.description_en: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
context.description_zh: 召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
facet_text_en: Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.
facet_text_zh: 召唤一个巨大的毒蛇守卫，攻击力为%mega_ward_multiplier_damage%倍，生命值和击杀金钱为%mega_ward_multiplier_health%倍。
context.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward

shard_loc.en: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
shard_loc.zh: 可以使用巨蟒之瓮技能制造一个巨蛇守卫。

context.description_en: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
context.description_zh: 斯拉达向前蜿行，移动速度得到显著提升，并且可以穿越单位。在最初%speed_burst_max_duration%内斯拉达获得%slow_resistance_tooltip%%%减速抗性。减速抗性会在剩余的冲刺时间内逐渐衰减。
facet_text_en: Slardar has slow resistance and even more movement speed at the beginning of Guardian Sprint.
facet_text_zh: 守卫冲刺开始时斯拉达获得减速抗性和额外的移动速度。
context.name: slardar_sprint
notes_en: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
notes_zh: 开启此技能不会打断持续施法。

context.description_en: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
context.description_zh: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
context.name: slardar_slithereen_crush

scepter_loc.en: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升鱼人碎击水洼的作用范围和持续时间。

shard_loc.en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
shard_loc.zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。

context.description_en: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
context.description_zh: %attack_count%次攻击后，下次攻击会重击目标。
context.name: slardar_bash
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
notes_zh: 不能与碎颅锤叠加。

context.description_en: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
context.description_zh: 斯拉达在水洼、水迹或河道中将获得移动速度、生命恢复、攻击力和护甲加成。
context.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel

scepter_loc.en: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有状态抗性。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升%scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%%，水洼的持续时间提升%scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%秒。

context.description_en: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
context.description_zh: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示隐身单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
facet_text_en: Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.
facet_text_zh: 斯拉达的护甲提升，数值为侵蚀雾霭降低护甲总数的%armor_pct%%%。
context.name: slardar_amplify_damage

context.description_en: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
context.description_zh: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
context.name: tidehunter_gush

scepter_loc.en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

context.description_en:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以%active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续%active_duration%秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
facet_text_en: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
facet_text_zh: 锚击效果下的敌方英雄阵亡会使海妖外壳获得永久伤害格挡。
context.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell

context.description_en: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
context.description_zh: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
context.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
notes_en: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

context.description_en: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.
context.description_zh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚%chain_length%距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至%max_movement_speed%，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受%attacks_to_destroy%次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。
context.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water

context.description_en: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
context.description_zh: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。
context.name: tidehunter_ravage
notes_en: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.
notes_zh: 毁灭能伤害隐身单位。
毁灭以%speed%的速度向外扩散。

context.description_en: Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
context.description_zh: 每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得%fish_health_bonus%点最大生命值，%fish_attack_range%攻击距离和%fish_damage_block%额外伤害格挡。潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。
context.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
notes_en: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.
notes_zh: 敌人可以摧毁鱼。
额外伤害格挡只会在有伤害格挡来源施加给即将受到的物理攻击时才会施加

context.description_en: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
context.description_zh: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
facet_text_en: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.
facet_text_zh: 麻痹药剂每次弹跳造成额外伤害。
context.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
notes_en: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
notes_zh: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。

context.description_en: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
context.description_zh: 巫医集中魔力治疗附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
facet_text_en: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.
facet_text_zh: 巫毒疗法对敌人造成伤害，只会治疗巫医自身。
context.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
notes_en: Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
notes_zh: 治疗间隔为%heal_interval%秒。
对减益免疫单位有效。

context.description_en: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
context.description_zh: 对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
facet_text_en: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
facet_text_zh: 被诅咒的敌人阵亡后会对%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，数值等于下次爆发伤害的%spread_pct%%%。
context.name: witch_doctor_maledict
notes_en: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
notes_zh: 受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。

context.description_en: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.
context.description_zh: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。
context.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo

context.description_en: Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.  Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.
context.description_zh: 巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每%gold_tick_interval_tooltip%秒会增加1金。右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。
context.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。死亡守卫拥有%bonus_accuracy%%%额外必中率。
facet_text_en: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.
facet_text_zh: 死亡守卫同时攻击%initial_target_count%个目标，但伤害降低。次级目标受到%secondary_attack_damage_pct%%%伤害。
context.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
notes_en: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
notes_zh: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。

scepter_loc.en: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。

context.description_en: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
context.description_zh: 丢下一个烟雾弹，沉默其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
context.name: riki_smoke_screen
notes_en: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
notes_zh: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。

shard_loc.en: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.
shard_loc.zh: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

context.description_en: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
context.description_zh: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成%slow_pct_tooltip%%%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
context.name: riki_blink_strike

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的%interval_targets%个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
facet_text_en: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.
facet_text_zh: 绝杀秘技攻击非英雄单位时拥有%creep_agility_multiplier%倍敏捷加成。只要力丸在绝杀秘技期间击杀一个非英雄单位，冷却时间就会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%秒。
context.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade

scepter_loc.en: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离至%AbilityCastRange%。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有%scepter_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升%scepter_bonus_duration%秒，并且额外发动%scepter_bonus_attacks%次攻击。

context.description_en: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
context.description_zh: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
facet_text_en: Riki receives bonus experience for assists and kills.
facet_text_zh: 力丸获得助攻和击杀时会获得额外经验。
context.name: riki_innate_backstab
notes_en: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.
notes_zh: 反补友方单位时具有%ally_multiplier%%%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。

context.description_en: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
context.description_zh: 力丸遁入阴影，变为隐身状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。
context.name: riki_backstab

context.description_en: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
context.description_zh: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被眩晕。每%tick_rate%秒眩晕一次。
context.name: enigma_malefice

shard_loc.en: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.
shard_loc.zh: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次眩晕都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

context.description_en: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
context.description_zh: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。
context.name: enigma_demonic_conversion

context.description_en: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
context.description_zh: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成%base_damage% + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
context.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

context.description_en: Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.
context.description_zh: %radius%范围内的单位远离谜团时会受到移速惩罚。
context.name: enigma_event_horizon

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
context.name: enigma_black_hole

scepter_loc.en: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.
scepter_loc.zh: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。

context.description_en: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
context.description_zh: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
context.name: tinker_laser

scepter_loc.en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
scepter_loc.zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。

context.description_en: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
context.description_zh: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
facet_text_en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
facet_text_zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。
context.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
notes_en: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.
notes_zh: 机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。

scepter_loc.en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
scepter_loc.zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

context.description_en: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
context.description_zh: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
context.name: tinker_deploy_turrets

scepter_loc.en: Turrets fire missiles %missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%% faster.
scepter_loc.zh: 炮塔发射导弹的速度加快%missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%%。

context.description_en: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
context.description_zh: 向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
context.name: tinker_warp_grenade
notes_en: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.
notes_zh: 最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。
context.name: tinker_rearm

context.description_en: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.
context.description_zh: 修补匠的每%int_per_one_cdr%点智力提供%one_percent_tooltip%%%物品冷却时间减少，最多为%max_cdr%%%。
context.name: tinker_eureka

context.description_en: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
context.description_zh: 消耗一点能量射出一发带有爆炸弹片的榴霰弹，在目标区域降下弹雨。区域内的敌军受到伤害并被减速。榴霰弹将给予目标区域的视野。榴霰弹的能量每过%abilitychargerestoretime%秒恢复1点。
facet_text_en: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.
facet_text_zh: 榴霰弹的减速和伤害提升，但是持续时间减少。
context.name: sniper_shrapnel
notes_en: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
notes_zh: 总共造成11次伤害，第一次在技能生效时，接下来每秒造成一次伤害。
不会对建筑造成伤害。
将拥有目标区域的视野。

context.description_en: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.
context.description_zh: 狙击手提高他的精确度，有一定概率造成%damage%点额外伤害并击退敌人。敌人距离狙击手越近，击退距离越远。爆头会短暂地降低敌人%slow%%%移动和攻击速度。
context.name: sniper_headshot

context.description_en:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
context.description_zh:
被动提升狙击手%passive_attack_range_bonus%攻击距离。

主动开启后，狙击手的视野距离、爆头几率和攻击距离提升。自身在持续时间内减速%slow%%%，并且视野限制在前方的锥形区域内。
context.name: sniper_take_aim

context.description_en: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
context.description_zh: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。
context.name: sniper_concussive_grenade

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.
shard_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，提升伤害并允许技能也能击退狙击手。

context.description_en: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.
context.description_zh: 狙击手和目标相距每%bonus_damage_distance%距离，他的攻击都会造成额外伤害。
context.name: sniper_keen_scope

context.description_en: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
context.description_zh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
context.name: sniper_assassinate
notes_en: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
notes_zh: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。

context.description_en: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
context.description_zh: 瘟疫法师向他的周围释放死亡波纹，伤害敌方单位并治疗友军单位。
context.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
notes_en: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.
notes_zh: 死亡脉冲不能被躲避。

context.description_en: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
context.description_zh: 瘟疫法师步入将生者与死者相隔的领域。散发出一片灵气，减缓周围敌人的移动速度。在这个形态下，瘟疫法师为虚无状态，无法攻击或被攻击，受到的魔法伤害增加，但是生命/魔法恢复效果加强。
facet_text_en: Necrophos gains movement speed equal to %movement_transfer%%% of the movement speed lost by enemies. Enemies lose %enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%% of the restoration amplification gained by Necrophos.
facet_text_zh: 瘟疫法师获得移动速度加成，数值等于%movement_transfer%%%敌人损失移速。敌人的恢复增强减少，数值等于瘟疫法师获得的%enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%%。
context.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud

context.description_en: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
context.description_zh: 瘟疫法师让敌人的心脏停跳，使附近敌方单位按最大生命值一定百分比持续流失生命。
context.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
notes_en: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 伤害不会禁用像闪烁匕首等物品。
不能作用于远古生物。

scepter_loc.en: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
scepter_loc.zh: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的%heal_regen_to_damage%%%。

context.description_en: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
context.description_zh: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。
context.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
notes_en: Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。

context.description_en: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
context.description_zh: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续%regen_duration%秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
context.name: necrolyte_sadist
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

context.description_en: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
context.description_zh: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
context.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
notes_en: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.
notes_zh: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。

context.description_en: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
context.description_zh: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
context.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
notes_en: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

context.description_en: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
context.description_zh: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被治疗。目标单位也会被治疗或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
context.name: warlock_shadow_word

scepter_loc.en: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的治疗和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%%。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多%abilitychanneltime%秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速%duration%秒。
context.name: warlock_upheaval
notes_en: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
notes_zh: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。

shard_loc.en: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
shard_loc.zh: 持续施法时每%imps_interval%秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

context.description_en: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
context.description_zh: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
context.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning

shard_loc.en: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
shard_loc.zh: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

context.description_en: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
context.description_zh: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，眩晕敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的减速抗性，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
facet_text_en: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
facet_text_zh: 混乱之祭地狱火会根据术士的生命和魔法恢复造成更高的永久献祭伤害。
context.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

scepter_loc.en: Calls %number_of_golems_scepter% Golems.
scepter_loc.zh: 召唤%number_of_golems_scepter%个地狱火。

context.description_en: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
context.description_zh: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
context.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
notes_en: This ability destroys trees.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁树木。

shard_loc.en: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
shard_loc.zh: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

context.description_en: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
context.description_zh: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。
context.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback

context.description_en: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
context.description_zh: 兽王召唤%hawk_count%只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以%hawk_base_attack_interval%秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并缠绕。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
context.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor

shard_loc.en: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.
shard_loc.zh: 战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

context.description_en: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
context.description_zh: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
facet_text_en: Attack Speed bonus is increased by the number of units affected by Inner Beast.
Can be activated to increase Beastmaster's attack speed and allow him to apply the Wild Axes damage amplification debuff on his attack target.
facet_text_zh: 攻击速度加成根据野性之心作用下的单位数量还会有所增加。
可以主动开启，提升兽王的攻击速度，并且他会对他的攻击目标施加野性之斧的伤害加深负面效果。
context.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
notes_en: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。

context.description_en: Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.
context.description_zh: 兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，%max_stacks%次攻击后降低至最短%min_drum_hit_interval%秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。使用原始咆哮时自动增加%primal_roar_stacks%层敲鼓叠加效果。
context.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom

context.description_en: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并眩晕，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得%movement_speed%%%移动速度提升，持续%movement_speed_duration%秒。
context.name: beastmaster_primal_roar

context.description_en: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
context.description_zh: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续%duration%秒。每%damage_interval%秒会再造成一次伤害。
context.name: queenofpain_shadow_strike
notes_en: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗影突袭变为%aoe_radius%范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。

context.description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
context.description_zh: 短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
context.name: queenofpain_blink
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。

shard_loc.en: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在%shard_aoe%范围内造成%shard_damage%点伤害，并沉默%shard_duration%秒。

context.description_en: The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.%damage_reflected_to_self%%% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
context.description_zh: 痛苦女王发出刺耳的尖叫，对周围敌人造成伤害。造成伤害的%damage_reflected_to_self%%%会反弹回她身上。
context.name: queenofpain_scream_of_pain
notes_en: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 痛苦尖叫能作用隐身单位。
痛苦尖叫无法被躲避。
对幻象造成的伤害不会反弹。反弹的伤害为减免前的，而且不致死。
反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

context.description_en: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.
context.description_zh: 所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到%close_radius%距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过%max_radius%距离时为最弱效果。
facet_text_en: Spell Lifesteal also applies to Pure & Magical reflected damage.
facet_text_zh: 技能吸血也对反弹的纯粹和魔法伤害有效。
context.name: queenofpain_succubus

context.description_en: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
context.description_zh: 痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
context.name: queenofpain_sonic_wave
notes_en: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.
notes_zh: 超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。

context.description_en: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
context.description_zh: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
context.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
notes_en: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every %tick_interval% seconds.
Slow starts at %movement_slow%%%, and decreases as time passes.
notes_zh: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每%tick_interval%秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为%movement_slow%%%，减速效果将逐渐降低。

shard_loc.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.
shard_loc.zh: 施法距离和弹道速度提升%shard_travel_tooltip%%%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造%num_created_wards_tooltip%个瘟疫守卫。

context.description_en: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.
context.description_zh: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。
context.name: venomancer_snakebite

context.description_en: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
context.description_zh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。
context.name: venomancer_plague_ward

context.description_en: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
context.description_zh: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
context.name: venomancer_poison_sting
notes_en: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
notes_zh: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。

shard_loc.en: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.
shard_loc.zh: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

context.description_en: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
context.description_zh: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
context.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
notes_en: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
notes_zh: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

context.description_en: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近%backtrack_duration%秒内受到的任何伤害。
context.name: faceless_void_time_walk
notes_en: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
notes_zh: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。

scepter_loc.en: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
scepter_loc.zh: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

context.description_en: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
context.description_zh: 虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
context.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
notes_en: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.
notes_zh: 不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。

shard_loc.en: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
shard_loc.zh: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。

context.description_en: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
context.description_zh: 攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标锁定在时间中，再次发动攻击。
context.name: faceless_void_time_lock
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。

context.description_en: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
context.description_zh: 时间漫游落地后1.5秒内可使用。施放时，自身将逆转时间漫游，回到上一个施放地点。不会影响生命值或触发神杖效果。
context.name: faceless_void_time_walk_reverse

context.description_en: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.
context.description_zh: 虚空假面附近%friendly_hero_distance%范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标%slow_distance_max%范围后会被减速%attack_projectile_slow%%%。
context.name: faceless_void_distortion_field

context.description_en: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
context.description_zh: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
context.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
notes_en: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.
notes_zh: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。

context.description_en: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
context.description_zh: 冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和眩晕，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。
context.name: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast

context.description_en: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
context.description_zh: 击杀2个非英雄单位可获得1点能量，击杀1名英雄可获得2点能量。可以主动使用，消耗所有能量点数召唤可以复活一次的骷髅兵。骷髅兵享受吸血灵魂的吸血效果。
context.name: skeleton_king_bone_guard
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
对敌人施放冥火爆击会导致骷髅兵攻击该敌人。

context.description_en: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
context.description_zh: 冥魂大帝被动地在攻击时造成额外伤害，本技能具有冷却时间。
context.name: skeleton_king_mortal_strike

shard_loc.en: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.
shard_loc.zh: 本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在%curse_delay%秒延迟后再次受到%curse_damage_pct%%%原攻击伤害的纯粹伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。

context.description_en: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
context.description_zh: 冥魂大帝获得吸血效果。被击杀时冥魂大帝变为移动无视地形的冥魂，拥有额外攻击和移动速度，持续较短时间，自身死亡延后。冥魂大帝变为冥魂后无法重生。
context.name: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
notes_en: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.
notes_zh: 对于死亡被延缓的友军，其成为冥魂前所受的最后一击来源即为击杀者。
触发绝冥再生时没有效果。
破坏只会使被动吸血失效。
复活时间会根据冥魂持续时间而减少。

scepter_loc.en: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.
scepter_loc.zh: 吸血灵魂变为光环，使友方英雄被击杀时也能变为冥魂。延长冥魂的持续时间。

context.description_en: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
context.description_zh: 冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近%slow_radius%范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
facet_text_en: When reincarnating, %shard_skeleton_count% skeletons are spawned and attack each nearby enemy hero.
When reincarnating, nearby enemy heroes have their curse cooldowns reset.
facet_text_zh: 重生过程中会产生%shard_skeleton_count%个骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。
重生过程中附近每个敌方英雄的诅咒冷却时间都会重置。
context.name: skeleton_king_reincarnation
notes_en: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
notes_zh: 如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 减少冷却时间。

context.description_en: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
context.description_zh: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
context.name: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
context.description_zh: 放出一个弹道，阻止目标区域内的敌人施放魔法。
facet_text_en: Silenced enemies are also slowed.
facet_text_zh: 被沉默的敌人也会被减速。
context.name: death_prophet_silence
notes_en: Doesn't prevent usage of items.
notes_zh: 不能阻止使用物品。

context.description_en: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
context.description_zh: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。
context.name: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
notes_en: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
notes_zh: 多个连接不能同时作用于一个目标。

shard_loc.en: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.
shard_loc.zh: 吸魂巫术的能量点数提升%shard_bonus_charges%点，敌人连续%shard_consecutive_siphon_duration%秒受到吸魂巫术作用后会被恐惧%shard_fear_duration%秒。

context.description_en: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.
context.description_zh: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。
context.name: death_prophet_witchcraft

context.description_en: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的治疗。对建筑造成50%%伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
context.name: death_prophet_exorcism
notes_en: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
scepter_loc.zh: 敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。

context.description_en: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
context.description_zh: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
context.name: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
notes_en: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
notes_zh: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

context.description_en: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
context.description_zh: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。
context.name: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike

context.description_en: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
context.description_zh: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
context.name: phantom_assassin_blur
notes_en: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.
notes_zh: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。

shard_loc.en: Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。

context.description_en: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
context.description_zh: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。
context.name: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives

context.description_en:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
context.description_zh:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。
context.name: phantom_assassin_immaterial

context.description_en: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
context.description_zh: 幻影刺客的战斗技能得到精进，每次攻击时有几率获得致命专注。攻击时若带有致命专注，幻影刺客会消耗该效果，并且必定产生一次致命一击。窒碍短匕拥有额外几率获得致命专注。
facet_text_en: Coup de Grace procs every %attacks_to_proc% attacks on the same hero or %attacks_to_proc_creeps% attacks on non hero units. Stifling Dagger counts as %two_tooltip% attacks.
facet_text_zh: 每攻击同个英雄%attacks_to_proc%次触发恩赐解脱，或者攻击同个非英雄单位%attacks_to_proc_creeps%次触发。窒碍短匕计为%two_tooltip%次攻击。
context.name: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace

context.description_en: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals %structure_damage_mod%%% damage to structures.
context.description_zh: 一个爆炸性脉冲，对敌方单位造成伤害。对建筑物造成%structure_damage_mod%%%伤害。
context.name: pugna_nether_blast
notes_en: Damage is delayed by %delay% seconds.
notes_zh: 伤害生效延迟为%delay%秒。

context.description_en: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
context.description_zh: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
context.name: pugna_decrepify
notes_en: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.
notes_zh: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

context.description_en: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
context.description_zh: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。
facet_text_en: Nether Ward restores mana and health to Pugna based on how much damage is dealt.
facet_text_zh: 幽冥守卫会根据造成的伤害使帕格纳回复魔法和生命。
context.name: pugna_nether_ward
notes_en: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.
notes_zh: 技能施放后幽冥守卫先造成伤害，技能才会生效，所以如果施法者因此阵亡，施放的技能将没有效果。
幽冥守卫可以受到衰老的作用。
幻象和非英雄单位对幽冥守卫造成25%的伤害。

shard_loc.en: Increases cast range to %AbilityCastRange%.
shard_loc.zh: 施法距离提升至%AbilityCastRange%。

context.description_en:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives %tower_scale%%% spell amplification per destroyed tower.
context.description_zh:
帕格纳可以在持续施法期间施放技能和使用物品。

每摧毁一座防御塔，帕格纳都会获得%tower_scale%%%技能增强。
context.name: pugna_oblivion_savant

context.description_en:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
context.description_zh:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。
context.name: pugna_life_drain

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard_loc.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

context.description_en: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型护盾，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和护盾效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果护盾被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的护盾，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
context.name: templar_assassin_refraction
notes_en: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
notes_zh: 生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。

shard_loc.en: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
shard_loc.zh: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

context.description_en: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for %debuff_duration% seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客将自己隐藏起来，只要静止不动将一直处于隐身状态。只要在隐匿状态下攻击敌人打破隐身，拉娜娅的攻击将对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低其护甲，持续%debuff_duration%秒。额外伤害和隐匿的负面效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
facet_text_en: Meld bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
When in Meld, Templar increases her attack range by up to an additional %attack_range_increase_max% range over %attack_range_increase_time%s.
facet_text_zh: 隐匿的额外伤害和护甲降低效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
隐匿状态下圣堂刺客会在%attack_range_increase_time%秒内逐渐提升她的攻击距离，最高为额外%attack_range_increase_max%距离。
context.name: templar_assassin_meld
notes_en: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.
notes_zh: 除了停留在原地或持续施放灵能投射，其他任何动作都会打破隐匿效果。
隐匿的护甲降低作用对防御塔无效。

context.description_en: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客锋利的灵能之刃可以穿透敌人，对其正后方的敌方单位造成伤害，并且攻击距离得到提升。每对一个单位造成伤害后，飞溅伤害都会减少一定百分比。
context.name: templar_assassin_psi_blades
notes_en: Split damage hits invisible units.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.
notes_zh: 飞溅伤害可以伤害隐身单位。
重击等攻击特效只对主目标有效。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for %abilitychanneltime% seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing %extra_damage% bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 圣堂刺客经过%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法后可以传送至任意灵能陷阱，到达时引爆灵能陷阱，陷阱总是最大效果，并且立刻造成%extra_damage%点额外伤害。灵能投射在持续施法时不会脱离隐匿效果。
context.name: templar_assassin_trap_teleport

context.description_en: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客放下一个隐形的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓%trap_radius%范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为%movement_speed_min%%%，放置%trap_max_charge_duration%秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为%movement_speed_max%%%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
context.name: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
notes_en: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
notes_zh: 陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。

scepter_loc.en: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 现在陷阱引爆后还会沉默受到作用的敌人。

context.description_en: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for %time_until_meditation%s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after %time_until_max_bonus%s of meditating.
context.description_zh: 原地不动且未受到伤害超过%time_until_meditation%秒后，圣堂刺客开始冥想，获得生命恢复和魔法恢复加成，冥想%time_until_max_bonus%秒后达到最大加成。
context.name: templar_assassin_inner_peace

context.description_en: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
context.description_zh: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。
context.name: viper_poison_attack

shard_loc.en: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.
shard_loc.zh: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

context.description_en: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
context.description_zh: 蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
context.name: viper_nethertoxin
notes_en: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.
notes_zh: 多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。

context.description_en: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
context.description_zh: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，%max_range%范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
context.name: viper_corrosive_skin
notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙%effect_multiplier_distance%范围内的敌人施加%effect_multiplier%倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在%nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%秒后，达到最高的%nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%%提升。

context.description_en: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
context.description_zh: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且%corrosive_radius%范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续%effect_duration%秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。
context.name: viper_nose_dive

context.description_en: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.
context.description_zh: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。
context.name: viper_predator

context.description_en: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
context.description_zh: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时破坏其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。
context.name: viper_viper_strike

context.description_en: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
context.description_zh: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂眩晕目标。
context.name: luna_lucent_beam

shard_loc.en: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.
shard_loc.zh: 每次一名敌方英雄被月光击中时，露娜都会获得一个攻击力加成的状态效果。月蚀的月光提供%damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%%数值。

context.description_en: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
context.description_zh: 产生%rotating_glaives%个月刃在露娜身旁%rotating_glaives_movement_radius%范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
facet_text_en: Rotating glaives provide damage reduction while active.
facet_text_zh: 旋转的月刃在开启时提供承受伤害降低的效果。
context.name: luna_lunar_orbit

shard_loc.en: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.
shard_loc.zh: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得%bonus_movement_speed%%%移动速度加成。

context.description_en: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
context.description_zh: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。
context.name: luna_moon_glaive
notes_en: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.
notes_zh: 月刃不会触发致命一击以外的任何攻击特效。

context.description_en: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
context.description_zh: 提升露娜和附近%radius%范围内友方英雄的攻击力，露娜获得双倍的攻击力加成。夜晚期间月之祝福为全地图生效，并且露娜受到福佑后夜间视野提升。
context.name: luna_lunar_blessing

context.description_en: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
context.description_zh: 召唤一次月蚀，以她当前技能等级的月光随机打击附近敌人。月光只有伤害效果，不会造成眩晕，而且单一目标只能受到有限次数的打击。月蚀会暂时将白天变为黑夜。
context.name: luna_eclipse
notes_en: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.
notes_zh: 如果露娜没有升级月光，月蚀将无法造成伤害，但是变为黑夜效果有效。
露娜阵亡后月光马上中止。
不能伤害隐身单位。
每道月光之间都有%beam_interval%秒的间隔。神杖升级后间隔为%beam_interval_scepter%秒。

scepter_loc.en: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
scepter_loc.zh: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。

context.description_en: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
context.description_zh: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
facet_text_en: Damage type changed to Physical.
facet_text_zh: 伤害类型改为物理。
context.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
context.description_zh: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成眩晕和伤害。
facet_text_en: Damage type changed to Physical.
facet_text_zh: 伤害类型改为物理。
context.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail

context.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
context.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。
context.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath

context.description_en: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
context.description_zh: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。
facet_text_en: Damage type changed to Physical.
facet_text_zh: 伤害类型改为物理。
context.name: dragon_knight_fireball

context.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
context.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升%regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%%。
facet_text_en: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
facet_text_zh: 攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害，并且技能和物品的作用范围提升。
攻击附带致命的毒素，可作用于敌方单位和建筑，降低护甲并持续造成物理伤害。
攻击带有冰霜，会作用于敌方单位，降低移动速度和攻击速度，同时降低生命回复。
context.name: dragon_knight_dragon_blood

context.description_en: Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
context.description_zh: 龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
context.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form

scepter_loc.en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
scepter_loc.zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

context.description_en: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
context.description_zh: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
context.name: dazzle_poison_touch
notes_en: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

context.description_en: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
context.description_zh: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
context.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
notes_en: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.
notes_zh: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

context.description_en: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
context.description_zh: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，治疗的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到治疗效果。
context.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
notes_en: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
notes_zh: 优先治疗友方英雄
如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为%scepter_heal_pct%%%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

context.description_en: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
context.description_zh: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
facet_text_en: Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
Weave applies %enemy_multiplier%x stacks to enemies.
facet_text_zh: 编织会对友军施加%ally_multiplier%倍叠加层数。编织的每层叠加效果会使来自戴泽的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果增强%heal_amplification_pct%%%。
编织会对敌人施加%enemy_multiplier%倍叠加层数。
context.name: dazzle_innate_weave

shard_loc.en: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
shard_loc.zh: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗%ally_heal%点。

context.description_en: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
context.description_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：剧毒之触带有妖术效果；薄葬结束时会治疗；暗影波的冷却时间变短。效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
context.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
notes_en: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
notes_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。

shard_loc.en: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
shard_loc.zh: 虚无投影可以在戴泽被控制时施放。他在虚无之境时治疗效果得到增强。

context.description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
context.description_zh: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
context.name: rattletrap_battery_assault
notes_en: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.
notes_zh: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

context.description_en: Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned. Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
context.description_zh: 在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
context.name: rattletrap_power_cogs
notes_en: Cogs can shock invisible units.
notes_zh: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

context.description_en: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供%duration%秒击中区域的视野。
context.name: rattletrap_rocket_flare

context.description_en: Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.Jetpack: Moves faster.Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
context.description_zh: 使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。喷气背包：移动得更快。持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
context.name: rattletrap_overclocking

context.description_en: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
