context.description_zh: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。
context.name: rattletrap_jetpack

context.description_en: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
context.description_zh: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近%stun_radius%范围内所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和眩晕。
facet_text_en: If there's another allied hero within %radius_ally% of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.
facet_text_zh: 如果发射钩爪击中的目标附近%radius_ally%范围内还有另一名友方英雄，那么发条技师和范围内所有友军都会获得护甲加成，并且部分退还冷却时间和魔法消耗。
context.name: rattletrap_hookshot
notes_en: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
notes_zh: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。

context.description_en:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
context.description_zh:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加%damage_per_armor%%%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
facet_text_en: Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
facet_text_zh: 发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
context.name: rattletrap_armor_power

context.description_en: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
context.description_zh: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
context.name: leshrac_split_earth
notes_en: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.
notes_zh: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过%delay%秒延迟后生效。

shard_loc.en: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location %shard_max_count% additional times, with a %shard_secondary_delay% second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by %shard_radius_increase%. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
shard_loc.zh: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复%shard_max_count%次，重复间隔为%shard_secondary_delay%秒。每次作用范围增加%shard_radius_increase%。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

context.description_en: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
context.description_zh: 使拉席克周围的区域充满魔法性爆炸，对敌方单位和建筑造成纯粹伤害。范围内的敌人越少，他们受到的伤害就越高。
facet_text_en: Diabolic Edict hits enemies with an increased explosion rate but it no longer damages buildings.
facet_text_zh: 恶魔敕令以更高的爆炸速度击中敌人，但是不再对建筑造成伤害。
context.name: leshrac_diabolic_edict
notes_en: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
notes_zh: 即使拉席克死亡，爆炸还是会在原地继续。

context.description_en: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.
context.description_zh: 召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。
context.name: leshrac_lightning_storm

context.description_en: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
context.description_zh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。
context.name: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm

context.description_en: Leshrac gains %aoe_per_int% Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.
context.description_zh: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供%aoe_per_int%作用范围加成。
context.name: leshrac_defilement

context.description_en: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.
context.description_zh: 拉席克在他周围创造破坏性的能量波，每秒对附近敌方单位造成伤害。每次脉冲都会消耗拉席克的魔法。
context.name: leshrac_pulse_nova

context.description_en: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
context.description_zh: 使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供%vision_range%范围内的视野。
facet_text_en: After Sprout is cast, all trees in a %healing_radius% radius emit an aura that heals nearby allies. Allied Tangos provide double the heal duration when consuming a tree created by Sprout.
facet_text_zh: 施放发芽后附近%healing_radius%范围内的树木会散发出治疗附近友军的光环。友军的树之祭祀吞食发芽产生的树木会提供双倍治疗时间。
context.name: furion_sprout
notes_en: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
notes_zh: 发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。

context.description_en: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
context.description_zh: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
context.name: furion_teleportation
notes_en: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.
notes_zh: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。

context.description_en: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
context.description_zh: 将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
facet_text_en: Summons a reduced number of stronger Treants with reinforced damage.
facet_text_zh: 召唤的树人数量减少，但是威力变大，而且拥有坚锐技能。
context.name: furion_force_of_nature
notes_en: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
notes_zh: 自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。

context.description_en: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within %range% range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within %radius% radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
context.description_zh: 对%range%范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据%radius%范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。
context.name: furion_curse_of_the_forest

context.description_en: Nature's Prophet gains %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
context.description_zh: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得%damage_per_tree_pct%%%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。
facet_text_en: Treant multiplier increased.
facet_text_zh: 树人的倍数增加。
context.name: furion_spirit_of_the_forest
notes_en: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.
notes_zh: 树人会从周围的树木和其他树人获得加成效果。
树精卫士不提供任何加成。

context.description_en: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit.
context.description_zh: 伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中%max_targets%个目标后达到最高伤害。
context.name: furion_wrath_of_nature
notes_en: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
notes_zh: 自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。

scepter_loc.en: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from %scepter_min_entangle_duration%s up to %scepter_max_entangle_duration%s seconds at max bounce.
scepter_loc.zh: 缠绕所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从%scepter_min_entangle_duration%秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为%scepter_max_entangle_duration%秒。

context.description_en:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
进入狂暴状态，变成减益免疫，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: life_stealer_rage

context.description_en: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
context.description_zh: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害回复一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
facet_text_en: Open Wounds' cooldown is refreshed if a unit dies while afflicted by Open Wounds.
facet_text_zh: 如果有单位在撕裂伤口效果下阵亡，撕裂伤口的冷却时间将会重置。
context.name: life_stealer_open_wounds
notes_en: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
notes_zh: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。

context.description_en: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
context.description_zh: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
facet_text_en: Feast's max HP per hero kill is increased.
facet_text_zh: 盛宴的击杀英雄获得生命上限已经提升。
context.name: life_stealer_feast
notes_en: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

context.description_en: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.
context.description_zh: 被动提升噬魂鬼的攻击速度。
context.name: life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy

context.description_en:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health. Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
facet_text_zh: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。感染可以对远古中立生物使用。
context.name: life_stealer_infest
notes_en: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。

shard_loc.en: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。

context.description_en: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
context.name: dark_seer_vacuum
notes_en: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.
notes_zh: 此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为%duration%秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。

context.description_en: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
context.description_zh: 将目标用一个尖刺之盾包裹起来，对周围的敌人造成伤害。
context.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
notes_en: Deals small amounts of damage in %tick_interval% second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.
notes_zh: 每%tick_interval%秒造成一次若干伤害。
离子外壳对其作用单位没有伤害。
如果对已经套上离子外壳的单位再次施放，新的离子外壳会取代旧的。

context.description_en: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
context.description_zh: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得相位移动状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
context.name: dark_seer_surge
notes_en: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
notes_zh: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。

shard_loc.en: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
shard_loc.zh: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为%trail_radius%，持续%trail_duration%秒，对附近的敌人造成%trail_move_slow%%%减速，并且每秒造成%trail_damage%点伤害，伤害间隔为%trail_damage_interval%秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

context.description_en: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.
context.description_zh: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去%recent_duration%秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和眩晕。移动%max_distance%距离以上将造成最大威力。
context.name: dark_seer_normal_punch

context.description_en:
Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.
context.description_zh:
黑暗贤者从每点智力获得%int_to_atkspd%攻击速度。

黑暗贤者升级时会恢复最大生命值和魔法值的一定百分比。
context.name: dark_seer_aggrandize

context.description_en: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
context.description_zh: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
context.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
notes_en: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
notes_zh: 幻象不会产生幻象。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

context.description_en: Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a %strafe_skeleton_radius% radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and %archer_attack_speed_pct%%% of the attack speed bonus.  Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
context.description_zh: 克林克兹获得攻击速度和攻击距离加成。克林克兹%strafe_skeleton_radius%范围内现有的骷髅弓手也会获得攻击距离加成和%archer_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度加成。施放扫射不会脱离骨隐步的隐身状态。
facet_text_en: Clinkz and each Skeleton Archer apply a stacking debuff, one stack per attacking Skeleton Archer, causing them to miss %bonus_blind_pct%%% of their attacks per stack for %debuff_duration%s. Applies to buildings as well.
facet_text_zh: 克林克兹和每个骷髅弓手都会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，每个攻击的骷髅弓手会施加一层叠加效果，每层会使目标的%bonus_blind_pct%%%攻击落空，持续%debuff_duration%秒。也会对建筑施加。
context.name: clinkz_strafe

context.description_en: Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for %skeleton_damage_pct%%% damage.
context.description_zh: 让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成%skeleton_damage_pct%%%伤害。
context.name: clinkz_searing_arrows
notes_en: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.
notes_zh: 灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。

context.description_en: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
context.description_zh: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
facet_text_en: Death Pact teleports Clinkz towards his victim. Reduces Death Pact cooldown. If Alt-Cast behavior is activated, or Clinkz is Rooted or Leashed, he will not teleport to the target location.
facet_text_zh: 死亡契约会把克林克兹传送至目标。降低死亡契约的充能时间。如果设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），或者克林克兹被缠绕或束缚，那他就不会传送至目标地点。
context.name: clinkz_death_pact
notes_en: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
notes_zh: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
context.name: clinkz_burning_barrage
notes_en: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.
notes_zh: 攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。

context.description_en: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.
context.description_zh: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。
context.name: clinkz_burning_army

context.description_en: Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal %skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
context.description_zh: 克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低%skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。
context.name: clinkz_wind_walk
notes_en: Has a fadetime of %fade_time% seconds.
notes_zh: 渐隐时间为%fade_time%秒。

context.description_en: Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to %max_armor_piercing_pct%%% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor).  Clinkz applies %hero_stacks%%% per attack, and skeletons apply %skeleton_stacks%%%. Lasts %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 克林克兹和他的骷髅弓手会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使他们的攻击可以穿透最高目标%max_armor_piercing_pct%%%总物理护甲（不会降低他们的护甲）。克林克兹每次攻击施加%hero_stacks%%%，骷髅弓手施加%skeleton_stacks%%%。持续%duration%秒。
context.name: clinkz_infernal_shred

context.description_en: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
context.description_zh: 立即治疗一个友方单位，并对周围的敌军造成伤害。
context.name: omniknight_purification

shard_loc.en: After a %recast_delay%s delay, the target is Purified again with %recast_effectiveness_pct%%% effectiveness.
shard_loc.zh: %recast_delay%秒延迟后目标会再次受到%recast_effectiveness_pct%%%威力的洗礼。

context.description_en: Grants Debuff Immunity with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.
context.description_zh: 提供减益免疫状态和%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性，以及额外生命恢复。
context.name: omniknight_martyr

context.description_en: Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration. Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 全能骑士将神圣之力注入他的战锤，使他的攻击距离提升，会根据基础攻击力的一定百分比造成纯粹伤害，并且使目标短时间内被减速。全能骑士会在%heal_duration%秒内回复%heal_pct%%%造成的伤害。
context.name: omniknight_hammer_of_purity

context.description_en: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
context.description_zh: 削弱过于靠近的敌方单位的移动能力，降低其移动速度。
facet_text_en: Omniknight's damage to a target is increased by %bonus_damage_per_stack%%% for every %stack_interval%s they spend affected by the aura.
facet_text_zh: 目标受到光环作用的时间每达到%stack_interval%秒，全能骑士对该目标的伤害都会增加%bonus_damage_per_stack%%%。
context.name: omniknight_degen_aura
notes_en: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位无效。

context.description_en: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
context.description_zh: 全能骑士召唤出守护天使，使全能骑士附近的所有友方单位对物理伤害免疫。
context.name: omniknight_guardian_angel

scepter_loc.en: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.
scepter_loc.zh: 守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

context.description_en: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
context.description_zh: 激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
context.name: enchantress_impetus
notes_en: The damage is capped at %distance_cap% distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.
notes_zh: 造成伤害上限的距离是%distance_cap%。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。

context.description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: Cast Range of Enchant is increased. If the enemy is a hero, Enchantress and units she controls have increased attack range against the target.
facet_text_zh: 魅惑的施法距离增加。如果目标是英雄，魅惑魔女和她控制的单位对目标的攻击距离增加。
context.name: enchantress_enchant
notes_en: Illusions can be converted.
notes_zh: 可以转化幻象。

scepter_loc.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

context.description_en: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
context.description_zh: 召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
facet_text_en: Whenever Enchantress takes more than %overprotective_damage_threshold% damage from enemy heroes, %overprotective_wisp_count% wisp appears for %overprotective_wisp_duration%s to heal her. A maximum of %overprotective_max_wisps% overprotective wisps can exist at the same time.
facet_text_zh: 只要魅惑魔女受到敌方英雄的伤害超过%overprotective_damage_threshold%点，%overprotective_wisp_count%个小精灵就会出现，%overprotective_wisp_duration%秒内进行治疗。同一时间最多只能存在%overprotective_max_wisps%个过度保护的小精灵。
context.name: enchantress_natures_attendants
notes_en: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
notes_zh: 不会选择满血单位进行治疗。

context.description_en: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the %attack_targets% furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + %bonus_attack_range%.
context.description_zh: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+%bonus_attack_range%范围内最远的%attack_targets%个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。
context.name: enchantress_bunny_hop

context.description_en: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 魅惑魔女缠绕一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续%duration%秒。
context.name: enchantress_little_friends

context.description_en: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
context.description_zh: 魅惑魔女让她的敌人神魂颠倒，受到他们攻击时会降低其攻击速度。
context.name: enchantress_untouchable
notes_en: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.
notes_zh: 所有直接攻击魅惑魔女的敌方单位都会被减速。
减速效果在攻击单位产生攻击动作时出现，而不是伤害生效时。

context.description_en: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
context.description_zh: 魅惑魔女使所有中立生物和魅惑魔女控制下的单位对敌方英雄造成额外伤害。
context.name: enchantress_rabblerouser
notes_en: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.
notes_zh: 不会影响劝化的中立生物、痛苦魔方和肉山。

context.description_en: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
context.description_zh: 在炽烈的狂暴下将附近所有敌人击退至固定距离外，造成伤害和沉默。
context.name: huskar_inner_fire

context.description_en: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
context.description_zh: 哈斯卡将其长矛点燃，在普通攻击的同时对敌方单位造成持续伤害。多次攻击会造成持续伤害叠加。每次攻击都将牺牲哈斯卡部分生命值。
facet_text_en: Burning Spears also burns enemies for a percentage of their max health. Costs Max Health instead of Current Health.
facet_text_zh: 沸血之矛还会燃烧敌人一定百分比的最大生命值。会消耗最大生命值，而不是当前生命值。
context.name: huskar_burning_spear
notes_en: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
notes_zh: 沸血之矛在多次施放到目标身上效果可以叠加。没有叠加上限。
哈斯卡不能使用此技能自杀。
炙矛可热不会对肉山造成额外的最大生命值烧灼伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
scepter_loc.zh: 沸血之矛会对哈斯卡攻击距离内随机敌人额外发射%multishot_targets%支长矛。

context.description_en: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
context.description_zh: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
facet_text_en:
Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facet_text_zh:
狂战士之血可以消耗一定生命来主动开启。驱散哈斯卡，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: huskar_berserkers_blood
notes_en: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
notes_zh: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，%hp_threshold_max%%%生命时达到最大加成。

shard_loc.en: Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散

context.description_en: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.
context.description_zh: 哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。
context.name: huskar_blood_magic

context.description_en:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.
facet_text_zh: 牺牲还会使目标附近的敌人减速。
牺牲还会治疗目标附近的友方单位。
context.name: huskar_life_break
notes_en: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。

scepter_loc.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

context.description_en: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
context.description_zh: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂眩晕，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
facet_text_en: Enemies affected by Void do not share vision with their allies. Affected enemies take damage per second when they are not visible to their allies.
Increases the max level of Void. Level %max_level% Void at night becomes ground targeted, increases movement and attack slow, and applies to a %cast_radius_tooltip% AoE.
facet_text_zh: 虚空作用下的敌人不会与友军共享视野。当不在友军视野中，他们会受到每秒伤害。
提升虚空的最高等级。%max_level%级虚空在夜间变为以范围为目标的技能，移动速度和攻击速度降低效果提升，并且施加%cast_radius_tooltip%范围效果。
context.name: night_stalker_void
notes_en: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
notes_zh: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。

special_values.heading_loc: DAMAGE PER SECOND WHEN NOT VISIBLE:
special_values.name: invisible_damage_pers

shard_loc.en: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
shard_loc.zh: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。

context.description_en: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
context.description_zh: 暗夜魔王恐吓附近所有敌人，使他们在他身边时被沉默，并受到伤害。效果在夜晚持续更久。
context.name: night_stalker_crippling_fear

context.description_en: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
context.description_zh: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时治疗自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
context.name: night_stalker_midnight_feast
notes_en: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.
notes_zh: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。

context.description_en: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
context.description_zh: 暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。
facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Hunter in the Night to %max_level_tooltip%. Night Stalker starts with a bonus level of Hunter in the Night.
facet_text_zh: 暗夜猎影的最高等级提升至%max_level_tooltip%级。暗夜魔王初始就额外拥有一级暗夜猎影。
context.name: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night

scepter_loc.en: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
scepter_loc.zh: 移动速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%%，攻击速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。

shard_loc.en: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
shard_loc.zh: 可以主动对一个普通单位施放暗夜猎影，将其秒杀并恢复暗夜魔王最大生命和魔法的一定百分比。在白天无法对远古生物施放。

context.description_en: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
context.description_zh: 暗夜魔王遮住太阳，让夜晚立刻降临，使他的力量可以得到最大程度的发挥。在此期间暗夜魔王获得飞行能力和攻击力加成。拥有顺畅视野。
context.name: night_stalker_darkness

context.description_en: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
context.description_zh: 对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
facet_text_en: Insatiable Hunger also applies to nearby Spiderlings.
facet_text_zh: 极度饥渴还会施加给附近的小蜘蛛。
context.name: broodmother_insatiable_hunger

shard_loc.en: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.
shard_loc.zh: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每%shard_damage_tick_interval%秒提升%shard_damage_per_tick%%%。

context.description_en: Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
context.description_zh: 编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
facet_text_en: Reduces health restoration of enemies on webs that are in the same web network as Broodmother.
facet_text_zh: 减少育母蜘蛛所在蛛网上敌人的生命回复。
context.name: broodmother_spin_web
notes_en: Also affects Spiderlings.
notes_zh: 也会作用于小蜘蛛。

context.description_en: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
context.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。
context.name: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
notes_en: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.
notes_zh: 攻击落空几率与闪避和上下坡丢失叠加。

context.description_en: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
context.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。
context.name: broodmother_sticky_snare

context.description_en: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a %kill_heal_aoe% radius receive a buff for %kill_heal_duration%s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every %tick_rate% seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by %kill_creeps_penalty%%%.
context.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和%kill_heal_aoe%范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续%kill_heal_duration%秒的状态效果，每%tick_rate%秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少%kill_creeps_penalty%%%。
context.name: broodmother_spiders_milk

context.description_en: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
context.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
context.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
notes_en: If the target is killed within %buff_duration% seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.
notes_zh: 如果目标在受到此技能后%buff_duration%秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。

context.description_en: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
context.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围%bounce_aoe%范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
context.name: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
context.description_zh: 赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。
context.name: bounty_hunter_jinada

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
context.description_zh: 赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂眩晕目标。
context.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
notes_en: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
notes_zh: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

context.description_en: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
context.description_zh: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是%fade_time%秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。
context.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.
context.description_zh: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升%kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。
context.name: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter

context.description_en: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
context.description_zh: 追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离隐身。
context.name: bounty_hunter_track
notes_en: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.
notes_zh: 只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。

context.description_en: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
context.description_zh: 编织者放出%count%只编织者幼虫，每只幼虫都会紧紧缠住它遇到的敌人，攻击敌人并削弱他们的护甲，直到幼虫被杀死。
facet_text_en: Weaver gains experience when The Swarm beetles attack heroes.
facet_text_zh: 虫群的甲虫攻击英雄时编织者会获得经验。
context.name: weaver_the_swarm
notes_en: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.
notes_zh: 甲虫抓住目标后将一直留在目标身上，除非甲虫被击杀或持续时间结束。
甲虫免疫技能，需要一个单位的%destroy_attacks%次攻击才能被击杀。英雄造成双倍伤害。
幼虫提供视野。

context.description_en: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
context.description_zh: 编织者进入隐身身，达到移动速度上限，在穿过敌方单位时还将造成伤害。
facet_text_en: Shukuchi movespeed increased and slows enemies when passing through them.
facet_text_zh: 缩地的移动速度增加，穿越敌人时会造成减速。
context.name: weaver_shukuchi
notes_en: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.
notes_zh: 每次施放的技能只能对相同单位造成一次伤害。

shard_loc.en: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
shard_loc.zh: 缩地在造成伤害的敌人身上留下一个标记，持续%geminate_attack_mark_duration%秒。编织者脱离缩地状态%shukuchi_attack_delay%秒后，附近%shukuchi_attack_mark_radius%范围内拥有印记的敌人都会被连击的第二次攻击击中。

context.description_en: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
context.description_zh: 允许编织者立刻发动两次攻击。
context.name: weaver_geminate_attack
notes_en: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
notes_zh: 第二次攻击将在编织者第一次攻击的%delay%秒后发出，并且没有距离限制。
额外伤害仅对连击的攻击有效，初始攻击没有额外伤害。

shard_loc.en: Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.
shard_loc.zh: 连击还会击中虫群附着目标%shard_beetle_search_range%范围内的单位。

context.description_en:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

驱散类型：强驱散
context.name: weaver_time_lapse
notes_en: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
notes_zh: 能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

scepter_loc.en: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 时光倒流可以对%abilitycastrange%施法距离内的友方英雄施放。

context.description_en: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.
context.description_zh: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们%thread_setup_distance%范围内停留达到%thread_setup_time%秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。
context.name: weaver_threads_of_fate

context.description_en: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
context.description_zh: 杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
context.name: jakiro_dual_breath
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
两次吐息有%fire_delay%秒的间隔。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
context.description_zh: 在杰奇洛前方制造一条冰封路径，对触及到的敌人造成伤害并眩晕。
facet_text_en: Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.
facet_text_zh: 杰奇洛可以选择随时摧毁冰封路径，再次对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
冰封路径的持续时间变长，并且结束时会引爆，再次对敌人造成伤害和眩晕。冰封路径可以手动提前引爆。
context.name: jakiro_ice_path
notes_en: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
notes_zh: 路径完全成形需要%path_delay%秒。
冰封路径消失后眩晕效果也会消失。

context.description_en: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
context.description_zh: 杰奇洛的火焰燃烧效果范围内的敌人，并降低他们的攻击速度。和液态冰共用冷却时间。
context.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
notes_en: Works on both units and buildings.
notes_zh: 对单位和建筑都有效。

shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。

context.description_en: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
context.description_zh: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续%duration%秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
context.name: jakiro_liquid_ice

shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

context.description_en: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
context.description_zh: 杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
facet_text_en: Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.
facet_text_zh: 杰奇洛的双重攻击造成更高伤害。
context.name: jakiro_double_trouble
notes_en: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
notes_zh: 第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。

context.description_en: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
context.description_zh: 杰奇洛释放出烈焰风暴，烈焰风暴作用范围很宽，并持续数秒。烈焰风暴每秒都会对作用范围内的敌人造成伤害。
context.name: jakiro_macropyre
notes_en: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.
notes_zh: 被烈焰焚身击中后离开区域还将额外受到%linger_duration%秒伤害效果。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速%ice_edge_movement_slow%%%。

context.description_en: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
context.description_zh: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。
facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Sticky Napalm. Level %max_level_tooltip% Sticky Napalm causes every attack to apply %napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip% stack of Sticky Napalm.
facet_text_zh: 提升粘性燃油的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级粘性燃油会使每次攻击施加%napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip%层粘性燃油。
context.name: batrider_sticky_napalm
notes_en: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to creeps.
notes_zh: 所有来自蝙蝠骑士的伤害均会加深，辉耀，淬毒之珠，影之灵龛和魂之灵瓮除外。
粘性燃油无需转身即可施放。
粘性燃油对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。

shard_loc.en: Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
shard_loc.zh: 粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。

context.description_en: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.
context.description_zh: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。
context.name: batrider_flamebreak

context.description_en: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
context.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士飞向天空，从空中留下一道燃烧的尾迹。飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。在火焰飞行持续时间的最后会达到最高移动速度加成。
facet_text_en: Firefly also lights Batrider on fire. He gains increasingly more Move Speed and burns away a portion of his max health each second. Maximum bonuses are reached at the end of Firefly's duration. Self-burn damage is constant and does not increase over time.
facet_text_zh: 火焰飞行还会使蝙蝠骑士着火。他每秒会被烧灼一定百分比的最大生命值，但是移动速度会逐渐大幅提升。对自身的烧灼伤害恒定，不会逐渐增加。
context.name: batrider_firefly
notes_en: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.
notes_zh: 火焰飞行期间蝙蝠骑士可以飞越任何单位，树木和不可通行的地形。
如果蝙蝠骑士在持续时间结束时正好在不可通行的地形上方，那么他将会卡住。
蝙蝠骑士死亡后火焰效果将继续存在。

context.description_en: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals %tick_attack_damage_pct%%% of the attack damage every %tick_rate%s for %total_ticks%s.
context.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士的攻击会施加一个负面效果，每%tick_rate%秒造成%tick_attack_damage_pct%%%攻击伤害，持续%total_ticks%秒。
context.name: batrider_smoldering_resin

context.description_en: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
context.description_zh: 用枷锁捆住一个敌人，在蝙蝠骑士的后面拖行。被拖行的单位不能移动、攻击或使用技能。传送或闪烁会打破枷锁。
context.name: batrider_flaming_lasso
notes_en: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.
notes_zh: 杀死目标或蝙蝠骑士都能在技能结束前打破枷锁。
如果蝙蝠骑士在0.05秒内移动距离超过425码枷锁将会断裂。
蝙蝠骑士在使用燃烧枷锁时不能攻击。

scepter_loc.en: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
scepter_loc.zh: 燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近%grab_radius_scepter%范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。

context.description_en: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.
context.description_zh: 对敌方单位造成伤害，并使其移动变慢，友军攻击他时攻速提升。
context.name: chen_penitence

context.description_en: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to %health_min%. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last %unsummon_time% seconds to unsummon it.
context.description_zh: 陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为%health_min%。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在%unsummon_time%秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。
context.name: chen_holy_persuasion
notes_en: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
notes_zh: 如果达到劝化生物的数量上限后再劝化生物，最早劝化的单位将立即死亡。
拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后可以对远古中立生物施放本技能。
升级此技能后在升级前劝化的单位并不会增加生命值。
劝化时单位的魔法恢复至满魔。

shard_loc.en: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.
shard_loc.zh: 神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。

context.description_en:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.
context.description_zh:
被动提供光环，提供生命恢复加成。可以主动对友军施放，提供护甲加成，以及治疗和生命恢复增强。

对陈施放后，陈控制的所有单位都会获得增益效果。
context.name: chen_divine_favor

context.description_en: Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy.  The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage.  The Zealot respawns next to Chen.Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay.  If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.
context.description_zh: 陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈身边复活。狂热者技能可以主动使用，在%teleport_delay%秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。
context.name: chen_zealot

context.description_en: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
context.description_zh: 治疗地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后%hot_duration%秒内持续进行小额治疗。
context.name: chen_hand_of_god
notes_en: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
notes_zh: 可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。

context.description_en: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
context.description_zh: 幽鬼掷出一把匕首，留下一条暗影之径，对路径上的敌人造成伤害并减缓其移动速度。被匕首击中的单位移动时也会留下暗影之径。幽鬼在暗影之径上移速提升，并且可以无视地形移动。
context.name: spectre_spectral_dagger
notes_en: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 在离开暗影之径后%dagger_grace_period%秒内碰撞体积依然为0，作为缓冲时间。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_en: Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
context.description_zh: 对目标制造一个无法控制的幻象，对其进行攻击。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
context.name: spectre_shadow_step

context.description_en: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
context.description_zh: 幽灵会分散对她造成的部分伤害，将其反弹给附近的所有敌人。敌人离她越远，受到的伤害越低。
context.name: spectre_dispersion
notes_en: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Illusions don't get this ability.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 幽鬼本身不承受被折射的伤害。
幻象并不继承此技能。
伤害在减免前折射，并且折射的伤害与原伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

shard_loc.en: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.
shard_loc.zh: 折射可以主动施放，吸收和反弹的伤害比例提升%activation_bonus_pct%%%，持续%activation_duration%秒。冷却时间为%activation_cooldown%秒。魔法消耗为%activation_manacost%点。

context.description_en: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
context.description_zh: 当敌人附近%radius%范围内没有他们的友军时，幽鬼和她的幻象的攻击对他们造成额外纯粹伤害。
facet_text_en: Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.
facet_text_zh: 幽鬼自身的荒芜造成%bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%倍伤害，但是幽鬼的幻象不再触发荒芜。
context.name: spectre_desolate
notes_en: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.
notes_zh: 伤害在幽鬼攻击前产生。
幽鬼的幻象继承荒芜。

context.description_en: Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
context.description_zh: 创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
context.name: spectre_haunt

scepter_loc.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。

context.description_en: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
context.description_zh: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
context.name: doom_bringer_devour
notes_en: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
notes_zh: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。

shard_loc.en: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

context.description_en: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
context.description_zh: 用火焰覆盖周围的土地，对敌人造成伤害，同时末日使者的移动速度和生命恢复得到提升。
context.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
notes_en: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.
notes_zh: 焦土会跟随末日使者，以他所在位置为中心。

context.description_en: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
context.description_zh: 末日挥舞他的炽烈之剑，将敌人点燃。造成%ministun_duration%秒眩晕，并施加一个燃烧效果，持续%burn_duration%秒，每秒造成伤害，数值为基础伤害+目标最大生命值的一定百分比。
context.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
notes_en: Interrupts channeling abilities.
notes_zh: 可以打断持续施法类技能。

context.description_en:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其无法施放技能或获得任何治疗效果，同时造成持续伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: Every %upgrade_interval% minutes, Doom's duration is increased by %upgrade_amount%s.
facet_text_zh: 末日的持续时间每%upgrade_interval%分钟都会提升%upgrade_amount%秒。
context.name: doom_bringer_doom

scepter_loc.en: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
scepter_loc.zh: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。末日作用下目标%scepter_aura_radius%范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

context.description_en: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
context.description_zh: 末日使者的攻击会诅咒敌方英雄。%damage_debuff_duration%秒后，被诅咒的英雄会爆发出一根火柱，对自身和%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量为诅咒期间内承受来自末日使者的%bonus_damage_pct_base%%%伤害。如果被诅咒的英雄等级为%level_multiplier%的倍数，诅咒的伤害和作用范围会提升%bonus_at_level_pct%%%。
context.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
notes_en: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.
notes_zh: 末日使者达到满级后也会生效。

context.description_en: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 对一个敌人施加诅咒，造成持续伤害。如果目标没有在%AbilityDuration%秒内远离初始地点走出足够距离，那么将被眩晕并冻在原地。
facet_text_en: Cold Feet becomes an AoE point targeted ability, with the radius depending on the current level of Ice Blast.
facet_text_zh: 寒霜之足变为范围型技能，作用范围取决于冰晶爆轰的当前等级。
context.name: ancient_apparition_cold_feet
notes_en: Deals damage every half second.
notes_zh: 每0.5秒造成一次伤害。

context.description_en: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
context.description_zh: 创造一个寒冰能量的漩涡，对范围内敌人造成伤害和减速，并增加他们受到的魔法伤害。
context.name: ancient_apparition_ice_vortex
notes_en: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.
notes_zh: 提供放置地点的小片视野。

context.description_en: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
context.description_zh: 使自己的普通攻击附带距离提升，高额魔法伤害和减速效果。
context.name: ancient_apparition_chilling_touch

scepter_loc.en: Removes cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 移除了冷却时间。

context.description_en: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
context.description_zh: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。
context.name: ancient_apparition_bone_chill

scepter_loc.en: Increases Base Strength Reduction by %tooltip_scepter_bonus%.
scepter_loc.zh: 基础力量降低提升%tooltip_scepter_bonus%。

context.description_en: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
context.description_zh: 向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
context.name: ancient_apparition_ice_blast
notes_en: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
notes_zh: 施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是%radius_min% + %radius_grow%*指向球的飞行时间，上限为%radius_max%。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。

shard_loc.en: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
shard_loc.zh: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足眩晕时间的%cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 熊战士向前跳跃%hop_distance%距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速%abilityduration%秒。
context.name: ursa_earthshock

shard_loc.en: Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 震撼大地对击中的敌人施加%fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit%层怒意狂击。

context.description_en: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
context.description_zh: 乌尔萨在战斗中运用他的技艺，提升了接下来几次攻击的攻击速度，同时还获得了减速抗性。
context.name: ursa_overpower
notes_en: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.
notes_zh: 攻击丢失还是会消耗超强力量的攻击次数。

context.description_en: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
context.description_zh: 熊战士的利爪深深地撕裂敌人的伤口，对同一敌人连续攻击将造成更多伤害。如果同一个目标在%bonus_reset_time%秒内不受攻击，将失去额外伤害加成。
context.name: ursa_fury_swipes
notes_en: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

context.description_en: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.
context.description_zh: 熊战士获得攻击力加成，数值为当前生命值的一定百分比。
context.name: ursa_maul

context.description_en:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
乌尔萨进入狂怒状态，承受的伤害降低并获得状态抗性。施放时将移除所受的负面效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
facet_text_en: When damaged during Enrage, Ursa gains bonus attack damage.
facet_text_zh: 激怒期间受到伤害时，熊战士获得攻击力加成。
context.name: ursa_enrage

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.
scepter_loc.zh: 减少冷却时间，而且熊战士可以在被控制的状态下使用激怒。

context.description_en: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
context.description_zh: 裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
facet_text_en: Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
facet_text_zh: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成会在冲刺结束后逐渐消失。
context.name: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
notes_en: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
notes_zh: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。

shard_loc.en: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
shard_loc.zh: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成提升%bonus_movement_speed%。

context.description_en: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
context.description_zh: 裂魂人获得移动速度和状态抗性加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。
context.name: spirit_breaker_bulldoze

context.description_en: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
context.description_zh: 攻击时有一定概率眩晕并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
facet_text_en: Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 过去%bonus_chance_duration%秒内对不止一名英雄触发了巨力重击就会使重击的概率提升。第一个英雄之后每个英雄都会使巨力重击的概率提升%bonus_chance_pct%%%。
context.name: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。
破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。

scepter_loc.en: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
scepter_loc.zh: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。

context.description_en: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
context.description_zh: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。
context.name: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
notes_en: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves %break_distance% units away from the target.
notes_zh: 如果裂魂人和目标之间的距离超过%break_distance%，位面空洞效果会停止。

context.description_en: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
context.description_zh: 裂魂人只要眩晕敌人就会获得移动速度加成。来自多个眩晕的效果会叠加，并且拥有独立的持续时间。暗影冲刺期间持续时间会暂停。
context.name: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
notes_en: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.
notes_zh: 神行太保的加成状态使裂魂人能够突破移动速度上限。

context.description_en: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
context.description_zh: 裂魂人遁入幽冥领域，从不幸的目标身旁再次出现，发动当前等级的巨力重击并造成额外伤害。击退距离为平常的两倍。
facet_text_en: Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.
facet_text_zh: 被幽冥一击击中的敌方目标受到友方的击退效果的移动距离更远。
context.name: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
notes_en: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
notes_zh: 裂魂人将在目标身后出现并发动巨力重击。

scepter_loc.en: Greatly increases knockback.
scepter_loc.zh: 大幅提升击退效果。

context.description_en: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 向矮人直升机附近一定范围内的敌方单位齐射导弹。持续%barrage_duration%秒。
facet_text_en: Every successful hit of a Rocket Barrage rocket on an enemy hero increases Gyrocopter's movement speed.
facet_text_zh: 火箭弹幕每次成功击中敌方英雄都会提升矮人直升机的移动速度。
context.name: gyrocopter_rocket_barrage
notes_en: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.
notes_zh: 火箭弹幕不能伤害矮人直升机视野之外的单位。
追踪导弹发射的火箭弹幕不会触发加力燃烧器。

context.description_en: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
context.description_zh: 发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及眩晕。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
context.name: gyrocopter_homing_missile
notes_en: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
notes_zh: 防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。

shard_loc.en: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
shard_loc.zh: 追踪导弹现在从施放%shard_delay%秒后开始不断发射%shard_radius%作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。

context.description_en: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds or until the attacks are used.
context.description_zh: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标周围一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。只有主要目标会受到致命一击等攻击特效。持续%abilityduration%秒或攻击次数耗尽。
context.name: gyrocopter_flak_cannon
notes_en: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.
notes_zh: 对主目标的攻击距离没有改变。

context.description_en: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.
context.description_zh: 矮人直升机通过攻击或技能对敌人造成伤害后，在短时间内获得移动速度提升。
context.name: gyrocopter_afterburner

context.description_en: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a %AbilityCastRange% unit radius every %sidegunner_fire_rate%s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
context.description_zh: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每%sidegunner_fire_rate%秒对矮人直升机附近%AbilityCastRange%范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
context.name: gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability
notes_en: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.
notes_zh: 即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。

context.description_en: Call down %total_strikes% aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is %strike_separation% distance from the previous one.
context.description_zh: 召唤%total_strikes%波防空导弹，对目标区域内的敌方单位造成减速和伤害。每次打击与上一次间隔%strike_separation%距离。
context.name: gyrocopter_call_down
notes_en: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.
notes_zh: 视觉指示范围仅对队友可见。

context.description_en: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
context.description_zh: 向目标区域喷洒高压酸雾。穿过受污染地带的敌人每秒会受到物理伤害，同时护甲被削弱。
context.name: alchemist_acid_spray

context.description_en: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
context.description_zh: 炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并眩晕。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，眩晕时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长眩晕时间。然而，若%brew_explosion%秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。
facet_text_en: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 炼金术士处于化学狂暴作用时，冷却时间减少%chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。
context.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction
notes_en: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.
notes_zh: 摇制开始后，本技能替换为投掷不稳定化合物。炼金术士在摇制期间可以像平常一样移动和攻击。
炼金术士的头顶会有倒计时，提示剩余的摇制时间。倒计时对敌人可见。
可以用此技能将自己反补。
不稳定化合物无法被躲避，并且不稳定化合物被掷出后会停止调制。
不稳定化合物的爆炸会对英雄和非英雄单位造成伤害。

context.description_en:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.
context.description_zh:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加%stacks_per_attack%层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加%one_tooltip%层叠加效果。
context.name: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry

special_values.heading_loc: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK:
special_values.name: attack_dmg_per_stack

context.description_en: Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh: 炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 炼金术士处于化学狂暴作用时，冷却时间减少%chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。
context.name: alchemist_berserk_potion

context.description_en: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
context.description_zh: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
facet_text_en: Alchemist gains %gpm_increase_per_stack% GPM for each Aghanim's Scepter he has granted to allies.
facet_text_zh: 炼金术士每对友军送出一把阿哈利姆神杖就获得%gpm_increase_per_stack%每分钟金钱。
context.name: alchemist_goblins_greed

scepter_loc.en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
scepter_loc.zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。

context.description_en:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
炼金术士诱发他的食人魔同伴进入化学狂暴，降低攻击间隔，提高移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: alchemist_chemical_rage
notes_en: Has a %transformation_time% second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.
notes_zh: 拥有%transformation_time%秒的变身时间，可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道以及眩晕技能。

context.description_en: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.
context.description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控冰元素。每个活跃的冰元素会让祈求者获得生命恢复加成。每级冰被动提供额外力量。
facet_text_en: <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional level.
facet_text_zh: <font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>会自动额外获得一级。
context.name: invoker_quas
notes_en: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个元素。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

scepter_loc.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
scepter_loc.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。

context.description_en: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.
context.description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控雷元素。每个活跃的雷元素会让祈求者获得移动和攻击速度加成。每级雷被动提供额外敏捷。
facet_text_en: <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional level.
facet_text_zh: <font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>会自动额外获得一级。
context.name: invoker_wex
notes_en: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

scepter_loc.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
scepter_loc.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。

context.description_en: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.
context.description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控火元素。每个活跃的火元素会让祈求者获得攻击力加成。每级火被动提供额外智力。
facet_text_en: <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional level.
facet_text_zh: <font color='#cabe68'>火</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#cabe68'>火</font>会自动额外获得一级。
context.name: invoker_exort
notes_en: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

scepter_loc.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
scepter_loc.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。

context.description_en: Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level.  Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level%, and %third_ability_level%.Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options.  The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen. Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
context.description_zh: 将当前掌握的元素精华融合，创造出新的法术供祈求者施放。每个元素球的等级都会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_orb%秒元素祈唤的冷却时间。祈求者达到%first_ability_level%、%second_ability_level%和%third_ability_level%时会分别额外获得一点技能点。祈求者高深的魔法学识让他可以从多个阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果中进行选择。物品必须先激活才能生效，而且选择后无法更改。点击帮助按钮可查看所有可用法术。
context.name: invoker_invoke
notes_en: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
notes_zh: 生成的技能与三个球的排列顺序无关。
只是交换现有技能的位置并不会消耗魔法，也不会触发元素祈唤的冷却。
元素祈唤不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

context.description_en: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.
context.description_zh: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续时间取决于冰元素等级。敌人将受到伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击会使敌人再次冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着冰元素等级提高而缩短。
context.name: invoker_cold_snap
notes_en: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.
notes_zh: 只有%damage_trigger%点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。
