context.description_zh: 美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
context.name: medusa_split_shot
notes_en: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
notes_zh: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

scepter_loc.en: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
scepter_loc.zh: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

context.description_en: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
context.description_zh: 放出一条秘术异蛇在敌人之间跳跃，造成伤害。每次跳跃后伤害和速度都会增加。抵达最后一个目标后，它会返回到美杜莎身上为其恢复魔法值。异蛇会返还所有目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。
facet_text_en: Mystic Snakes returning to Medusa empower her next %max_attacks% attacks with +1 additional damage for each %mana_per_damage% mana restored. Lasts up to %attack_buff_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 秘术异蛇返回至美杜莎后，根据异蛇回复的魔法值，每%mana_per_damage%点魔法都会使她接下来的%max_attacks%次攻击附带+1 额外伤害。加成状态持续最多%attack_buff_duration%秒。
context.name: medusa_mystic_snake
notes_en: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 秘术异蛇无法躲避。

context.description_en: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
context.description_zh: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出%volley_count%组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。
context.name: medusa_gorgon_grasp

context.description_en: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.
context.description_zh: 美杜莎受到指向性技能作用后会对该敌人放出单体的秘术异蛇，把他们变成石头，持续%stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%秒。
context.name: medusa_cold_blooded

context.description_en: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
context.description_zh: 创造一个魔法护盾，消耗美杜莎的魔法值以吸收%absorption_pct%%%的伤害。幻象的伤害吸收系数减少%illusion_percentage%%%。
facet_text_en: Mana Shield can be activated, draining %aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%% of max mana per second to gain %aspd_increase_rate_pct%%% attack speed bonus per second, up to %aspd_increase_max_tooltip%%%. Maximum effect reached after %aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%s. Buff lasts %aspd_increase_buff_duration%s and Cooldown is %attack_buff_cooldown%s.
facet_text_zh: 魔法盾可以主动开启，每秒消耗%aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%%最大魔法值并每秒获得%aspd_increase_rate_pct%%%攻击速度加成，最高为%aspd_increase_max_tooltip%。%aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%秒后获得最大效果。加成状态持续%aspd_increase_buff_duration%秒。冷却时间为%attack_buff_cooldown%秒。
context.name: medusa_mana_shield
notes_en: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.
notes_zh: 伤害的吸收先于任何伤害减免机制，所以提高物理护甲，物理格挡和魔法抗性都不能减少吸收相同伤害所需的魔法。

context.description_en: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
context.description_zh: 任何盯着蛇发女妖的敌方单位的攻击速度和移动速度均将被减缓。如果一单位在石化凝视期间盯着蛇发女妖超过%face_duration%秒，该单位会被完全石化。被石化的单位处于眩晕状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。
context.name: medusa_stone_gaze
notes_en: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.
notes_zh: 无论敌方单位是在美杜莎施放技能期间的何时受到石化凝视作用，他受到的技能效果都是满额的持续时间。

context.description_en: Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.
context.description_zh: 巨魔战将从使用远程攻击切换为近战攻击。近战下巨魔战将的基础攻击间隔降低至%base_attack_time%。巨魔战将每拥有%attack_speed_interval%攻击速度加成获得%armor_per_interval%点护甲。
context.name: troll_warlord_switch_stance

context.description_en: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
context.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出手中的五把飞斧，减速并伤害前方%axe_range%范围锥形区域内的敌方单位。
context.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
notes_en: Does not affect Roshan.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 无法作用于肉山。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散

context.description_en: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
context.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。
context.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
notes_en: Does not affect Roshan.
notes_zh: 无法作用于肉山。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散

context.description_en: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
context.description_zh: 当巨魔战将持续攻击同一个目标时，他会攻击得越来越快。如果改变目标，则额外的攻速加成清零。
facet_text_en: Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.
facet_text_zh: 近战形态下热血战魂的叠加效果提供护甲。
context.name: troll_warlord_fervor
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏会使阿哈利姆魔晶的几率触发失效。

shard_loc.en: Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.
shard_loc.zh: 巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有%base_chance%%% + 热血战魂叠加次数*%extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%%的几率对远程攻击距离 + %range_buffer%范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。

context.description_en: While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
context.description_zh: 近战形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率触发诱捕，阻止目标移动或使用位移类技能。另外近战形态下还拥有额外移动速度。远程形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率使目标残废，造成额外伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。
context.name: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage

context.description_en:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes %attack_speed_share_percent%%% of the attack speed bonus.
facet_text_zh: 战斗专注期间巨魔战将的热血战魂叠加层数上限变高，而且没有攻击速度上限。战斗专注为友方英雄提供%attack_speed_share_percent%%%攻击速度加成。
context.name: troll_warlord_battle_trance
notes_en: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
notes_zh: 巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。

context.description_en: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.
context.description_zh: 经过短暂的蓄力后，半人马战行者猛踏地面，眩晕并伤害身边的敌方单位。在延迟期间，他被缴械，但可以移动。
context.name: centaur_hoof_stomp

context.description_en: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
context.description_zh: 半人马战行者以猛烈的力量进行近战攻击，对目标周围单位和自身造成伤害。将基于力量值造成额外伤害。此技能无法用于自杀。
context.name: centaur_double_edge
notes_en: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.
notes_zh: 双刃剑对目标和自身都造成魔法伤害。

shard_loc.en: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of %shard_max_stacks% stacks.
shard_loc.zh: 双刃剑可以对敌人造成减速，并且每击中一名英雄都会暂时提升半人马战行者的力量值。每次叠加都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加%shard_max_stacks%次。

context.description_en: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
context.description_zh: 半人马战行者向攻击他的单位发出反击。反弹固定伤害加上自身力量的一定百分比。对防御塔的伤害减半。
context.name: centaur_return
notes_en: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 反伤会在受到攻击时触发。
反伤能对防御塔造成伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

context.description_en: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
context.description_zh: 半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。
context.name: centaur_work_horse

context.description_en: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
context.description_zh: 半人马战行者带领所有队友向胜利冲锋，所有友方英雄达到极限移动速度，并使踩到的敌人减速。每个敌人只会受到一次踩踏作用，并受到基于半人马战行者力量值的伤害。
context.name: centaur_stampede

context.description_en: Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed. This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.
context.description_zh: 半人马战行者获得移动速度加成，数值为%strength_to_movement_pct%%%自身力量值。这个移动速度加成不与鞋类物品叠加。
context.name: centaur_horsepower

context.description_en: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。
facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level %max_level% Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's current location after reaching max length. The return Shockwave travels %return_shockwave_bonus_distance% distance further and hits enemies a second time for %return_damage_pct_tooltip%%% of the damage.
facet_text_zh: 提升震荡波的最高等级。%max_level%级震荡波会在到达最大长度后会返回至马格纳斯的当前位置。返回的震荡波行进距离增加%return_shockwave_bonus_distance%，对再次击中敌人并造成%return_damage_pct_tooltip%%%伤害。
context.name: magnataur_shockwave

context.description_en:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
context.description_zh:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
context.name: magnataur_empower
notes_en: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

context.description_en: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
context.name: magnataur_skewer
notes_en: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。

shard_loc.en: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
shard_loc.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

context.description_en: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。
context.name: magnataur_horn_toss

context.description_en: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯的减速抗性得到提升，并且受到敌人技能和物品的击退效果减少。
context.name: magnataur_solid_core

context.description_en: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和眩晕。
context.name: magnataur_reverse_polarity

context.description_en: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
context.description_zh: 伐木机使极其锋利的刀刃飞旋，对敌人造成伤害并摧毁他周围的树木。如果敌方英雄受到了作用，他的主属性将在短时间内降低少许。如果该技能施放过程中砍倒了树木则会根据砍倒的数量造成额外伤害。
context.name: shredder_whirling_death

context.description_en: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.
context.description_zh: 伐木机发射一条锯链，锯链会嵌入第一棵碰到的树里，然后将他拉向那棵树。行进过程中任何碰到的敌方单位都会受到伤害。
facet_text_en: When Timbersaw collides with the target tree, it shatters, sending %tree_splinter_count% splinters in all directions, up to %tree_splinter_distance% distance. If a splinter hits an enemy, they take damage and are slowed for a brief duration.
facet_text_zh: 伐木机与目标树木相撞时，树木会破碎，向四面八方放出%tree_splinter_count%片碎木，最远为%tree_splinter_distance%距离。如果碎木击中了敌人，将会造成伤害和短时间的减速。
context.name: shredder_timber_chain

context.description_en: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as %stacks_per_hero_attack%x the amount.
context.description_zh: 伐木机每受到一次物理攻击，他的生命恢复和护甲值都会提升。英雄攻击提供%stacks_per_hero_attack%倍提升。
context.name: shredder_reactive_armor
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

scepter_loc.en: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and %initial_shield% damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw %shield_per_sec% + %shield_per_sec_per_enemy% barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within %radius% radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of %max_shield%. After %duration% seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within %explosion_radius% radius equal to %base_explosion% + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.
scepter_loc.zh: 活性护甲可以主动施放，获得最大叠加次数和%initial_shield%点生命的护盾。护盾的恢复速度为每秒%shield_per_sec% + 伐木机%radius%范围内每名敌方英雄都会增加%shield_per_sec_per_enemy%，最高为%max_shield%。%duration%秒后伐木机会对%explosion_radius%范围内每个英雄造成伤害，数值为%base_explosion% + 护盾剩余生命，而且失去全部护盾。

context.description_en: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
context.description_zh: 伐木机向面朝的方向放出一道火焰。施加一个负面效果，造成每秒伤害，并减缓敌人的移动速度。对建筑造成的伤害有所减少。
context.name: shredder_flamethrower

context.description_en: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
context.description_zh: 伐木机将主锯刃射向目标区域，锯刃会高速旋转，对周围的敌方单位造成伤害。在锯刃作用范围内的敌方单位每损失最大生命值的%slow_health_percentage%%%，他们的移动速度都会进一步被降低。锯刃在发射和收回的过程中都将造成伤害并砍倒碰到的树木。在发射锯刃后伐木机将无法攻击，同时会持续消耗魔法。
context.name: shredder_chakram
notes_en: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.
notes_zh: 如果伐木机魔法不足或移动超过%break_distance%距离，锯齿飞轮将会飞回。

context.description_en: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
context.description_zh: 伐木机只要摧毁一棵树就会获得魔法。
context.name: shredder_exposure_therapy

context.description_en: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
context.description_zh: 用鼻涕包裹一个敌方单位，降低护甲和移动速度，持续%goo_duration%秒。多次施放的效果会叠加，并且刷新持续时间。
facet_text_en: Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.
facet_text_zh: 提升了最大叠加层数和每层护甲降低。
context.name: bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo

context.description_en: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 将尖刺喷射向敌人，对钢背兽附近的敌人造成伤害。任何单位最近%quill_stack_duration%秒内每次受到刺针扫射的打击都会受到额外伤害。
context.name: bristleback_quill_spray
notes_en: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 刺针扫射的伤害不能被伤害格挡类技能减免。

context.description_en: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
context.description_zh: 如果伤害来自钢背兽的侧面或者背后，他所受的伤害将会降低。钢背兽每次从背后受到一定量伤害会自动释放一次当前等级的刺针扫射。
facet_text_en: Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.
facet_text_zh: 他受到伤害时不再释放刺针扫射，而是对附近所有敌人发射当前等级的粘稠鼻液。
context.name: bristleback_bristleback
notes_en: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 钢背兽的背面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈70度角的扇形区域。
钢背兽的侧面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈110度角的扇形区域，背面的扇形区域不算在内。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，%activation_delay%秒后以%activation_spray_interval%秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出%activation_num_quill_sprays%次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓%activation_movement_speed_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
context.description_zh: 向目标地点咳出一团满是刺针的毛团。毛团会在该地点爆开，范围内的敌人都将受到多个鼻液叠加效果和单次刺针扫射的作用。
context.name: bristleback_hairball

context.description_en: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
context.description_zh: 钢背兽每次使用技能时都会进入狂暴状态，移动速度和攻击力都将提升。
facet_text_en: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.

Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.
facet_text_zh: 战意提供攻击速度加成，而不只有攻击力。
战意可以主动开启，获得额外的攻击力和移动速度加成，持续较短时间。红光满面期间，钢背兽的视野减少至狭窄的锥形，并且不会获得友军的视野。
context.name: bristleback_warpath
notes_en: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 钢背兽的幻象也能继承加成效果。
使用物品不会触发战意。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

context.description_en: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.
context.description_zh: 钢背兽攻击身后的敌方英雄时拥有额外伤害和负面效果持续时间增强。
context.name: bristleback_prickly

context.description_en: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for %shard_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民将数块寒冰碎片压缩成蕴含冰冻能量的冰球，对所有接触到冰球的敌人造成伤害。冰球到达目标地点时会产生一个障碍物，持续%shard_duration%秒。
context.name: tusk_ice_shards
notes_en: Creates an impassable barrier.
notes_zh: 将创造不可通行的障碍。

context.description_en: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民开始卷成雪球。右键点击%snowball_grab_radius%范围内的友方英雄能使其加入雪球。发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被眩晕并受到伤害。雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和眩晕时间都会得到提升。
context.name: tusk_snowball
notes_en: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.
notes_zh: 雪球在发动后经过最大3秒将会解体。
使用发动雪球技能就能提前发动雪球。
幻象不会进入雪球，但是米波的克隆体以及巨牙海民控制的其他单位将一同进入雪球。
米波的分身也能卷入雪球，并提升雪球的伤害。
队友可以点击雪球，使自己进入雪球。

context.description_en: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。持续%debuff_duration%秒。
context.name: tusk_tag_team
notes_en: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.
notes_zh: 影响来自友方英雄、巨牙海民和他控制的所有单位的普通攻击。

context.description_en: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民伸出手来触碰友方单位，拉近彼此。触碰后巨牙海民和他的友军获得移动速度和护甲加成。
context.name: tusk_drinking_buddies
notes_en: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within %min_distance% range of each other.
Cannot be used during Snowball.
notes_zh: 如果巨牙海民和目标友军相距在%min_distance%距离以内，就不会拉动他们。
在雪球期间无法使用。

context.description_en: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% if kicking a creep.
context.description_zh: 将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成眩晕，伤害和减速。另外对落地区域%search_radius%范围内所有英雄造成伤害。飞踢非英雄单位会使冷却时间减少%creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。
context.name: tusk_walrus_kick

context.description_en: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民为他强力的海象神拳做好准备，下一次攻击将会造成额外伤害并暴击，同时将目标打到半空中。
context.name: tusk_walrus_punch
notes_en: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.
notes_zh: 海象神拳！拥有克敌机先效果。

context.description_en: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a %radius% unit radius.
context.description_zh: 被动降低%radius%范围内所有敌方英雄的攻击速度。
context.name: tusk_bitter_chill

context.description_en: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
context.description_zh: 天怒法师施放出缓慢移动的奥术鹰群，对敌方单位造成基于天怒法师智力值的伤害。
context.name: skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt
notes_en: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 鹰群移动得非常缓慢（500移速），提供325范围的视野。击中目标后，将给予目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。
奥法鹰隼无法被躲避。

shard_loc.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
shard_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放奥法鹰隼时，会产生%total_bolt_count%个鹰隼，其中一个飞往原目标，而另外的两个飞往原目标附近%extra_bolt_search_radius%范围内随机敌人。以英雄为首要目标。

context.description_en: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
context.description_zh: 天怒法师释放一个远距离的光弹，将击中超大范围内最近的英雄。击中后会对英雄附近范围内所有单位造成伤害和减速。
context.name: skywrath_mage_concussive_shot
notes_en: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
notes_zh: 如果作用范围内没有英雄或英雄处于迷雾中，震荡光弹将以最近的敌方小兵或中立生物为目标。
击中英雄后附近的非英雄单位也会受到伤害。
光弹将给予400范围的附近视野，击中后将获得目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。

scepter_loc.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放震荡光弹时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

context.description_en: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
context.description_zh: 天怒法师利用上古符文将目标单位封印，目标单位将被沉默，受到魔法伤害时将承受额外伤害。
context.name: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
notes_en: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
notes_zh: 减少魔法抗性的效果对非英雄单位无效。

scepter_loc.en: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放上古封印时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

context.description_en: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
context.description_zh: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得小型的魔法伤害护盾。每个加成状态独立叠加。
context.name: skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion

context.description_en: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 天怒法师操控终极魔力，召唤精准致命的奥术力场毁灭对手。%duration%秒期间对范围内所有敌方英雄造成大量伤害，伤害由所有英雄平摊。
context.name: skywrath_mage_mystic_flare
notes_en: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
notes_zh: 神秘之耀只会作用于英雄。神秘之耀不会对类英雄单位造成伤害。
神秘之耀在没有敌方英雄时将对敌方非英雄单位造成伤害。
神秘之耀会立刻摧毁幻象。

scepter_loc.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within %scepter_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
scepter_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放神秘之耀时，原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人的位置上也会产生一个神秘之耀。以英雄为首要目标。

context.description_en: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
context.description_zh: 亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾，可以对敌方单位造成伤害，或者治疗友方单位。
facet_text_en: Mist Coil also deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% attack damage and applies effects from items and abilities. Self Damage increased when targeting enemies.
facet_text_zh: 迷雾缠绕还会造成%damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%%攻击伤害，并且施加物品和技能的效果。对敌人施放时对自身的伤害增加。
context.name: abaddon_death_coil
notes_en: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.
notes_zh: 亚巴顿不能使用此技能自杀。

context.description_en:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
召唤黑暗能量环绕友方单位，驱散他们并创造一个全伤害护盾，护盾在消失前能吸收一定量的伤害。护盾消失或被摧毁后将会爆炸，对附近区域的单位造成伤害，伤害值为护盾的最大吸收量。

驱散类型：强驱散
facet_text_en: Damage barrier amount increased, but no longer bursts upon expiration. %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies. Increases cooldown.
facet_text_zh: 伤害护盾数值提升，但是护盾被摧毁后不再爆炸。%absorb_to_damage%%%吸收伤害会反弹给附近的敌人。增加冷却时间。
context.name: abaddon_aphotic_shield
notes_en: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
notes_zh: 不论护盾因持续时间结束或吸收足够伤害后被摧毁都将造成最大伤害。
爆炸将不会对战争迷雾内单位造成伤害。

shard_loc.en: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
shard_loc.zh: 会对附近敌人造成吸收伤害的%absorb_to_damage%%%。

context.description_en: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%%.
context.description_zh: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少%tower_dps_pct%%%。
context.name: abaddon_frostmourne

context.description_en: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for %duration%s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by %heal_reduction_pct%%% if they are below %hp_threshold_pct%%% HP.
context.description_zh: 对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续%duration%秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于%hp_threshold_pct%%%，那么生命回复会降低%heal_reduction_pct%%%。
context.name: abaddon_withering_mist

context.description_en:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
启动后驱散自身，所有受到的伤害转而产生治疗效果。只要技能不在冷却中，在生命值低于%hp_threshold%点时技能会自动启动。

驱散类型：强驱散
facet_text_en: While Borrowed Time is active, Abaddon and enemies within %immolate_aoe% radius take %immolate_damage% damage per second.
facet_text_zh: 回光返照生效时亚巴顿和%immolate_aoe%范围内的敌人每秒会受到%immolate_damage%点伤害。
context.name: abaddon_borrowed_time
notes_en: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
notes_zh: 在亚巴顿受到眩晕作用时依然可以手动开启回光返照，但是受到沉默作用时不可以。不过被沉默时被动效果依然能生效。
无光之盾在回光返照生效期间不会吸收伤害，因此也不会影响治疗效果。
破坏会使回光返照无法自动触发。

scepter_loc.en: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than %ally_threshold_scepter% damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升持续时间。启动回光返照后，亚巴顿附近迷雾缠绕的施法距离内友方英雄受到的伤害超过%ally_threshold_scepter%点时亚巴顿就会自动对其施放迷雾缠绕。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。
context.name: elder_titan_echo_stomp
notes_en: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
notes_zh: 若同时处于灵体游魂和上古巨神的回音重踏作用范围内将受到两次伤害。

shard_loc.en: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.
shard_loc.zh: 减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。

context.description_en:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
context.description_zh:
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。

灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。
context.name: elder_titan_ancestral_spirit

scepter_loc.en: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
scepter_loc.zh: 游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得%scepter_magic_immune_per_hero%秒减益免疫状态和%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性提升。

context.description_en: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
context.description_zh: 使所有元素降低至基础水平，移除附近敌方单位的基础物理护甲和魔法抗性。护甲降低效果以英雄为中心，魔法抗性降低效果以灵体游魂为中心。
facet_text_en: Every %tick_rate%s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by %armor_per_tick%, and magic resistance is reduced by %magic_resistance_per_tick%%%. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
facet_text_zh: 敌方英雄在自然秩序效果下每停留%tick_rate%秒，他们的护甲就会降低%armor_per_tick%点，魔法抗性降低%magic_resistance_per_tick%%%。叠加效果最多可叠加%max_stacks%次。
context.name: elder_titan_natural_order
notes_en: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
notes_zh: 没有施放灵体游魂时，护甲和魔法抗性降低效果均以上古巨神为中心。

shard_loc.en: Every %tick_rate%s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by %armor_per_tick%, and magic resistance is reduced by %magic_resistance_per_tick%%%. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
shard_loc.zh: 敌方英雄在自然秩序效果下每停留%tick_rate%秒，他们的护甲就会降低%armor_per_tick%点，魔法抗性降低%magic_resistance_per_tick%%%。叠加效果最多可叠加%max_stacks%次。

context.description_en: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
context.description_zh: 上古巨神获得额外护甲，数值为移动速度加成的一定百分比。
context.name: elder_titan_momentum
notes_en: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.
notes_zh: 移动速度加成是指高于基础移动速度的部分。
上古巨神被减速到低于基础移动速度时动量不会降低上古巨神的护甲。

context.description_en: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
context.description_zh: 上古巨神向前方放出一道不平坦的裂纹。3秒后裂纹塌陷，范围内的单位将被减速，并受到基于他们自身生命最大值的伤害。其中一半伤害为魔法伤害，另一半为物理伤害。
context.name: elder_titan_earth_splitter

context.description_en: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a %movement_slow%%% impact slow for %slow_duration%s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
context.description_zh: 用敌人的数量反制他们，对附近的所有敌人造成伤害，击中时施加%movement_slow%%%减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。范围内每个敌方单位和英雄都会使伤害提升。另外还会向军团指挥官提供攻击速度加成。
context.name: legion_commander_overwhelming_odds

shard_loc.en: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.
shard_loc.zh: 压倒性优势的范围更大，会根据对敌方英雄造成的伤害提供全伤害护盾。

context.description_en:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
移除友方目标单位的负面效果和控制技能，并提升其移动速度和生命恢复，持续一定时间。

驱散类型：强驱散
context.name: legion_commander_press_the_attack

scepter_loc.en: Increases movement speed and becomes an %radius% area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升移动速度，变为%radius%范围型技能，而且使用时总是会作用于军团指挥官。

context.description_en: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
context.description_zh: 每当受到攻击达到一定次数，军团指挥官都会对目标立即作出反击，而且此次攻击具有吸血效果。
context.name: legion_commander_moment_of_courage
notes_en: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.
notes_zh: 只有在攻击他人时受到攻击才会触发带有吸血的反击。

context.description_en: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within %radius% range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for %duration%s; allies gain %ally_factor%%% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.
context.description_zh: 如果军团指挥官或附近%radius%范围内的友方英雄施放技能，他们会获得%duration%秒的护甲加成；其中友军获得的数值为%ally_factor%%%。这个加成效果独立叠加。
context.name: legion_commander_outfight_them

context.description_en: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 军团指挥官强制与目标敌方英雄进行决斗，持续短暂的数秒。决斗开始后双方英雄不能使用任何物品，而目标敌方英雄不能使用技能。如果有英雄在决斗期间死亡，赢得决斗的英雄将永久获得攻击力加成。
context.name: legion_commander_duel
notes_en: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
notes_zh: 如果双方距离超过2000，决斗也会结束。

scepter_loc.en: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
scepter_loc.zh: 如果军团指挥官在决斗中获胜，会在她周围自动触发强攻。

context.description_en: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
context.description_zh: 灰烬之灵释放出火焰绳索来缠绕附近的敌人，将他们困于原地并每秒造成一定伤害。
context.name: ember_spirit_searing_chains
notes_en: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.
notes_zh: 将随机选取炘周围的单位作为目标。
不能作用于减益免疫或隐身单位。

context.description_en: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
context.description_zh: 灰烬之灵以燎原之火的速度横冲直撞，攻击目标区域内所有敌人，随后返回所在位置。对英雄造成额外伤害。
facet_text_en: When Sleight of Fist connects with %min_enemies_for_double_sleight% or more enemies, the enemy closest to Ember Spirit will be attacked a second time. Damage for the second attack is reduced by %second_attack_damage_penalty%%%.
facet_text_zh: 无影拳击中的敌人超过%min_enemies_for_double_sleight%个时，距离灰烬之灵最近的敌人会再次受到攻击。第二次攻击的伤害减少%second_attack_damage_penalty%%%。
context.name: ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist
notes_en: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every %attack_interval% seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.
notes_zh: 在施放技能时作用的目标就已决定。
对目标的攻击每次间隔为%attack_interval%秒。
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。
施放无影拳时间可以使用其他技能和物品。

context.description_en: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
context.description_zh: 灰烬之灵用火焰之环将自己包裹起来，会消耗受到的魔法伤害，使受到的魔法伤害被吸收一定百分比。烈火罩开启后会对灰烬之灵周围的敌人造成每秒伤害。护盾消失后将失去伤害效果。
context.name: ember_spirit_flame_guard
notes_en: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional %linger_duration% seconds after application.
notes_zh: 魔法伤害的吸收伤害值计算先于任何伤害减免效果。
伤害在施加后会额外粘滞%linger_duration%秒。

context.description_en: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
context.description_zh: 选择残焰，灰烬之灵将向其冲去。
context.name: ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant

context.description_en: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
context.description_zh: 灰烬之灵持续燃烧，时刻对周围所有敌人造成每秒伤害。
context.name: ember_spirit_immolation
notes_en: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
notes_zh: 破坏不会使阿哈利姆魔晶升级的残焰继承的献祭心失效。

shard_loc.en: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.
shard_loc.zh: 使残焰获得献祭心，并且每秒伤害和作用范围提升。

context.description_en: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
context.description_zh: 可以放出一个残焰，向目标地点冲去，速度为灰烬之灵移动速度的%speed_multiplier%%%。使用“激活残焰”技能后，灰烬之灵向所有残焰像冲去，将其摧毁并造成范围伤害，并移动至最近的残焰像。灰烬之灵最后会到达离目标地点最近的残焰像。
context.name: ember_spirit_fire_remnant
notes_en: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
notes_zh: 学习后马上拥有3个残焰（上限数量）。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。

shard_loc.en: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
shard_loc.zh: 灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。

context.description_en: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a %remnant_smash_radius_tooltip% radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.
context.description_zh: 大地之灵将敌方单位或友方单位作为目标，将其击飞，目标将沿他面朝的方向飞行一段距离。如果大地之灵点地为目标，他将击飞%remnant_smash_radius_tooltip%范围内距离最近的单位，优先以残岩为目标。击飞的单位或残岩会对碰到的所有单位造成伤害。如果敌人是被残岩击中还将额外被减速。残岩被击飞的距离比其他单位更远。
context.name: earth_spirit_boulder_smash

context.description_en: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
context.description_zh: 大地之灵化身为巨石，经过%delay%秒延迟后向目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和眩晕，伤害值为%damage% + %damage_str%%%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的眩晕时间更长。
facet_text_en: Stone Remnants are not destroyed when rolled over, and the cooldown of Stone Remnant is refreshed when the roll is done.

Rolling over an allied hero grants the allied hero and Earth Spirit %allied_bonus_movespeed%%% bonus movespeed for %allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%s. If he rolls over an allied hero, Earth Spirit will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer,
facet_text_zh: 残岩在翻滚时经过不会被摧毁，而且翻滚结束后残岩的冷却时间会重置。
滚过一名友方英雄后会使该友方英雄和大地之灵获得%allied_bonus_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，持续%allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%秒。而且滚过友方英雄时，大地之灵滚动的距离变远，速度变快，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人的时间也变长。
context.name: earth_spirit_rolling_boulder
notes_en: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.
notes_zh: 翻滚时经过残岩会将其摧毁。
巨石的作用范围为%radius%。
大地之灵在滚动时无法作为目标，而且无敌。

context.description_en: Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
context.description_zh: 大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。拉扯的残岩也会对击中的敌人造成伤害。以友军为目标时施法距离减少。
context.name: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
notes_en: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
notes_zh: 如果目标处于时间结界，决斗或黑洞之中则不起作用。
地磁之握还可以对友方小兵施放。

shard_loc.en: Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少至%AbilityCooldown%秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。

context.description_en: Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
context.description_zh: 在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得%attack_damage_per_stone%%%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得%attack_damage_per_stone_used%%%攻击力加成，持续%buff_duration%秒（无法叠加）。
facet_text_en: Has a fixed cooldown instead of charges.
facet_text_zh: 拥有固定的冷却时间，而不是能量点数。
context.name: earth_spirit_stone_caller

context.description_en: Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
context.description_zh: 大地之灵对一名英雄施法，使其暂时获得残岩的属性。经过短时间后残岩就会碎裂，释放出英雄，并对周围单位造成伤害。可以对残岩施放。对残岩施放时冷却时间为5秒。对友方英雄施放时施法距离更远。
context.name: earth_spirit_petrify
notes_en: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.
notes_zh: 如果大地之灵自身受到残岩魔咒的效果，也可以成为巨石冲击的目标。

context.description_en: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
context.description_zh: 将附近小范围内的敌方单位磁化，使其短时间内受到伤害。被磁化的英雄单位将会引起附近残岩的爆炸，每次爆炸都将摧毁残岩并刷新残岩附近单位身上的磁化时间（若附近单位未被磁化则为其施加一个磁化效果）。该过程可重复数次。如果一个被磁化的英雄受到了地磁之握或巨石冲击的作用，那么所有被磁化的英雄都会受到同样效果。
facet_text_en: Magnetizing a Stone Remnant gives Earth Spirit bonus attack damage for %magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration% seconds. Does not stack.
facet_text_zh: 磁化一个残岩会让大地之灵获得攻击力加成，持续%magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration%秒。不会叠加。
context.name: earth_spirit_magnetize

context.description_en: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
context.description_zh: 恐怖利刃映出目标区域内所有敌方英雄的黑暗倒影对其进行反制，目标在短时间内将被自身倒影攻击，移动速度和攻击速度都会降低。倒影为无敌状态。
context.name: terrorblade_reflection
notes_en: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.
notes_zh: 无法以倒影的幻象为目标，并且幻象为无敌，减速效果被移除后幻象将被摧毁。
倒影只会攻击该技能指定的目标。

context.description_en: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
context.description_zh: 创造一个恐怖利刃的幻象，可以攻击敌人造成伤害。
facet_text_en: Conjure Image illusions always spawn at full health and cost health instead of mana.
facet_text_zh: 惑幻的幻象总是满血，但施放时消耗生命，而不是魔法。
context.name: terrorblade_conjure_image
notes_en: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.
notes_zh: 惑幻产生的幻象在外观上与普通幻象不同。

context.description_en: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
context.description_zh: 恐怖利刃变换形态，化身成可怕的恶魔并具备远程攻击能力。任何恐怖利刃的幻象在%metamorph_aura_tooltip%范围内也将魔化。
context.name: terrorblade_metamorphosis
notes_en: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.
notes_zh: 近战或远程物品的冷却时间不同时将根据恐怖利刃在使用物品时处于远程或近战形态而定。

context.description_en: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
context.description_zh: 施放需消耗恐怖利刃当前生命值的一部分，为恐怖利刃和他附近的幻象提供生命恢复、移动和攻击速度加成。不会影响倒影的幻象。魔化状态下无法施放，而且施放魔化会移除狂魔效果。
context.name: terrorblade_demon_zeal

context.description_en: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
context.description_zh: 放出一道能量波，朝所有方向向外行进，击中敌方英雄将使其恐惧并造成伤害，同时恐怖利刃短时间内获得魔化状态。
context.name: terrorblade_terror_wave

context.description_en: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
context.description_zh: 隔断恐怖利刃以及目标英雄的灵魂并将双方的当前血量百分比进行互换。交换后双方英雄的生命值必定在一定百分比以上。
facet_text_en: There is no minimum health threshold for Sundered enemies.
facet_text_zh: 魂断对敌人施放时没有最低生命值限制。
context.name: terrorblade_sunder
notes_en: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
notes_zh: 减益免疫的敌人不会被影响生命值。

context.description_en: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
context.description_zh: 恐怖之刃控制的附近幻象拥有额外攻击伤害。
context.name: terrorblade_dark_unity
notes_en: Reflection Illusions are also affected.
notes_zh: 倒影的幻象也会受到作用。

context.description_en: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
context.description_zh: 凤凰向目标方向进行圆弧状飞行，飞行距离固定，对沿途的敌人造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度，然后返回初始位置。飞行过程中如果施放超新星将停止飞行。
context.name: phoenix_icarus_dive
notes_en: Icarus Dive has a %dive_duration% second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.
notes_zh: 凤凰冲击的飞行时间为%dive_duration%秒，可以在飞行途中再次施放来终止飞行。

context.description_en: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
context.description_zh: 召唤4只围绕凤凰飞行的烈火精灵。每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
context.name: phoenix_fire_spirits
notes_en: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
notes_zh: 烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。

shard_loc.en: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.
shard_loc.zh: 烈火精灵变成被动充能技能。具有7秒充能时间。

context.description_en: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
context.description_zh: 凤凰以损失生命能量为代价，向前射出一束炽热的光线炙烤敌人。光线对敌人造成伤害，并且能治疗友军，伤害和治疗的数值均为基础数值加上目标最大生命值的一定百分比。随着光线不断炙烤，百分比也会不断增加。
context.name: phoenix_sun_ray
notes_en: Sun Ray has a width of %radius% units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
notes_zh: 烈日炙烤的宽度为%radius%，长度为%abilitycastrange%。
凤凰受到眩晕、沉默、飓风、妖术或睡眠等效果时烈日炙烤将会中断。
凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。

shard_loc.en: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
shard_loc.zh: 超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。

context.description_en: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.
context.description_zh: 凤凰每秒对%radius%范围内所有敌人造成%damage_pct%%%自身缺失生命值的魔法伤害。
context.name: phoenix_dying_light
notes_en: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.
notes_zh: 消逝之光在凤凰变身为超新星期间也会造成伤害。

context.description_en:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
凤凰十分乐意终结自己现在的生命来换取重生。将自己变为一颗燃烧的恒星，灼烧附近一大片区域内的敌人。恒星受到敌方英雄一定次数的攻击后将会被摧毁。经过%abilityduration%秒后恒星将会爆炸，眩晕周围所有敌人。而凤凰的生命和魔法值都会回到满状态，并且所有技能的冷却时间都会刷新。

驱散类型：强驱散
context.name: phoenix_supernova

scepter_loc.en: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.
scepter_loc.zh: 摧毁超新星所需的攻击次数增加，凤凰可以对友方英雄施放超新星，使双方共同变为恒星进行重生。

context.description_en:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
持续施法 - 将神谕者的力量汇聚为一股蕴含荡涤之力的能量，对敌方目标释放这股能量可以对其造成伤害，使其被缠绕，并且驱散其附近区域的魔法效果。如果目标是友军，将只造成驱散效果。缠绕时间随着持续施法时间逐渐提升。

驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: oracle_fortunes_end
notes_en: Affects invulnerable units.
notes_zh: 可以作用无敌单位。

context.description_en: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance.
context.description_zh: 神谕者让目标沉醉，将其缴械并提升其%magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%%魔法抗性。
context.name: oracle_fates_edict

context.description_en: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
context.description_zh: 将目标身上一切不洁之物净化，对其造成大量魔法伤害，并使其在接下来的一段时间内逐渐恢复生命值。恢复的生命值总量将超过受到的伤害。可对友方和敌方单位施放。
context.name: oracle_purifying_flames
notes_en: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.
notes_zh: 涤罪之焰的治疗效果可以相互叠加。
涤罪之焰的伤害对友军不会致死。

context.description_en: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
context.description_zh: 在目标范围内降下大雨。站在该区域的敌人受到每秒伤害，并且治疗增强被削弱。区域内友军被治疗，并且具有治疗增强效果。
context.name: oracle_rain_of_destiny

context.description_en:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
暂时篡改队友的命运，技能期间受到的任何治疗和伤害效果将在虚妄之诺结束后结算，其中治疗效果结算时效果更强。施放时将移除目标身上大部分的负面状态效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
context.name: oracle_false_promise
notes_en: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.
notes_zh: 伤害和治疗效果虽然被延缓结算，但是结算时依然会考虑护甲和魔法抗性的减免。
经过延缓的伤害和治疗效果在目标失去本技能效果后立刻结算。

context.description_en: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.
context.description_zh: 神谕者将预测并对友军宣布，下个强化神符出现的地点（上路或下路），以及肉山的准确复活时间。
context.name: oracle_prognosticate

context.description_en: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 向目标区域抛出一个粘性炸弹。如果炸弹落在一个敌方英雄身旁，炸弹会粘上去，减缓其移动速度。数秒后炸弹会爆炸，对爆炸区域内造成伤害，并再次施加减速，持续%secondary_slow_duration%秒。
context.name: techies_sticky_bomb

context.description_en: Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 工程师对友军目标放出电荷，使他们短时间内获得移动速度加成。攻击目标的敌人会受到伤害被暂时缴械，并且受到弱驱散效果。效果结束时，或者用子技能提前引爆后电荷将会爆炸，使范围内所有敌人缴械并受到伤害。
context.name: techies_reactive_tazer

context.description_en: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
context.description_zh: 工程师冲到敌人中间，在相遇时引爆炸药，造成大量范围伤害，并眩晕敌人。引爆时会对工程师造成当前生命值一定百分比的非致死伤害。
facet_text_en: Increased Blast Off! damage and self damage.
facet_text_zh: 提升爆破起飞！伤害和对自身伤害。
context.name: techies_suicide
notes_en: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
This ability destroys trees.
notes_zh: 工程师在此次爆炸中受到的自身伤害为纯粹伤害，而且不会致死。
此技能将摧毁树木。

context.description_en: Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
context.description_zh: 工程师获得相当于最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法恢复。工程师阵亡时，他们会留下一个木桶，在%explosion_delay%秒后爆炸，对范围内敌人造成伤害。伤害数值是根据工程师的最大魔法值。
context.name: techies_mutually_assured_destruction

shard_loc.en: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.
shard_loc.zh: 同归于尽变为主动技能。提升最大魔法值的伤害系数。工程师放置同归于尽木桶后，可以使用子技能手动引爆。同一时间主动技能只能放下一个同归于尽木桶。

context.description_en: Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%%% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.When an enemy Hero walks within %trigger_radius% units of a minefield sign, the %aura_radius% units area around the sign will become a minefield for %minefield_duration% seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
context.description_zh: 在指定地点放置警示牌，使作用范围内的感应地雷为无敌状态，并且造成的伤害增加%bonus_mine_damage_pct%%%。同一时间只能存在一个标识。持续%lifetime%秒。敌方英雄进入标识的%trigger_radius%范围内时标识附近整个%aura_radius%范围变成一片雷区，持续%minefield_duration%秒。敌方单位在区域内移动都会受到伤害。雷区持续时间结束后标识会被摧毁。
context.name: techies_minefield_sign

context.description_en: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
context.description_zh: 埋布隐形的地雷，不会被真实视域检测到，但是有敌方单位在地雷的%radius%生效范围内会显形。敌人在生效范围内停留超过%proximity_threshold%秒会使地雷爆炸，并且魔法抗性会被暂时降低。爆炸对%min_distance%范围内目标造成全额伤害，对边缘造成的伤害减少至%outer_damage%%%。对建筑物造成%building_damage_pct%%%伤害。
context.name: techies_land_mines
notes_en: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
notes_zh: 感应地雷的%placement_radius%范围内不能再放置地雷。
感应地雷不会阻止中立生物产生。
地雷持续时间没有上限，除非爆炸或被摧毁。
隐形单位也能触发地雷。
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。

context.description_en: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second.
context.description_zh: 寒冬飞龙乘着一股极地寒风扶摇而上，移动将无视地形，每次攻击都将呼出逼人的寒气。高飞时，她的攻击距离更远，攻击弹道速度也更快，被攻击的敌人在寒意作用下，移动速度会被减缓，同时每秒损失%percent_damage%%%当前生命值。
context.name: winter_wyvern_arctic_burn
notes_en: This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
notes_zh: 本技能无法作用于肉山。
寒冬飞龙的攻击前摇降低至%attack_point%秒。
严寒烧灼的持续伤害和减速可以被驱散。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
scepter_loc.zh: 严寒烧灼变成开关型技能，开启后每秒消耗一定量魔法。提升寒冬飞龙的移动速度。

context.description_en: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
context.description_zh: 向一个单位发射一团易碎的冰球。冰球一击中目标就会碎裂，而目标单位将不会受到任何效果，但是附近%split_radius%基础范围内敌人都将因碎片的冲击受到伤害，并且移动速度减缓%movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%。
context.name: winter_wyvern_splinter_blast
notes_en: The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.
notes_zh: 主弹道的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
主弹道无法被躲避，而且不能以寒冬飞龙自身为目标。

context.description_en: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
context.description_zh: 将队友封入一个冰茧中，使其被冻在原地并恢复生命值，恢复数值为基础数值加上最大生命值的一定比例。冰茧将阻隔一切物理伤害。
facet_text_en: Cold Embrace can be cast on buildings. Does not heal buildings. Allied units and buildings gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon. Duration is paused if the building is protected by both Glyph of Fortification and Cold Embrace.
facet_text_zh: 极寒之拥可以对建筑施放。不会治疗建筑。冰茧中的友方单位和建筑在冰茧解冻后获得攻击力加成。如果建筑同时处于极寒之拥和防御符文的作用，极寒之拥的持续时间会暂停。
context.name: winter_wyvern_cold_embrace

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %shard_cooldown_reduction% seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%shard_cooldown_reduction%秒。友方单位从冰茧解冻后获得额外攻击力。

context.description_en: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%%% of its current value at the time of consumption.
context.description_zh: 寒冬飞龙获得物品“古龙诗集”，可以消耗，使一个基础技能的当前和最高等级均提升一级，另外寒冬飞龙的基础智力提升，数值为消耗时相应数值的%tooltip_int_pct%%%。
context.name: winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda

context.description_en: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
context.description_zh: 寒冬飞龙驱散一个敌方目标并将其冻在原地，附近的其他敌人将受到癫狂诅咒，对冻住的队友进行攻击，而且攻击速度得到提升。冻住的目标和被诅咒攻击队友的敌人不会受到任何来自敌方的伤害，不过寒冬飞龙或她控制的单位造成的伤害除外。敌方英雄进入施放后的诅咒范围内会增加诅咒的持续时间。
context.name: winter_wyvern_winters_curse
notes_en: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.
notes_zh: 如果目标被其队友击杀，击杀者将仍是寒冰飞龙。
无视主目标的减益免疫状态，但是对目标周围的减益免疫队友无效。

context.description_en: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
context.description_zh: 将不稳定的涡流能量灌注到落单敌人体内，造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度。如目标周围有其他敌方单位 ，则不会造成伤害。
context.name: arc_warden_flux

scepter_loc.en: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.
scepter_loc.zh: 目标落单时乱流具有沉默效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

context.description_en: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
context.description_zh: 天穹守望者制造一个充满磁能的圆形扭曲力场。磁场提供攻击速度加成，并且其中的友方单位可以闪避来自磁场外的攻击。磁场可以牵引神符，并且自动激活其中的神符。
facet_text_en: Magnetic Field pulls runes. Runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
facet_text_zh: 磁场会牵引神符。磁场内的神符会自动激活。
context.name: arc_warden_magnetic_field

context.description_en: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
context.description_zh: 召唤一个缓慢实体化的闪光怨灵萦绕在目标区域，直到有敌人进入范围。一旦有敌方单位进入范围，怨灵将贴近敌人自我熔化，造成魔法伤害并使目标减速。
context.name: arc_warden_spark_wraith
notes_en: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.
notes_zh: 闪光幽魂无法被躲避。

context.description_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
context.description_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。
facet_text_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
facet_text_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。
context.name: arc_warden_runic_infusion

context.description_en: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
context.description_zh: 天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
facet_text_en:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Power Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Level 1 - Arcane Rune.

Level 2 - Arcane and Invisibility Runes.

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.
facet_text_zh:
风暴双雄产生时带有强化神符的加成效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

1级 - 奥术神符。

2级 - 奥术和隐身神符。

3级 - 奥术、隐身和极速神符。
context.name: arc_warden_tempest_double
notes_en: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
notes_zh: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。

shard_loc.en: The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。不会触发神符灌注。

context.description_en: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
context.description_zh: 召唤数波火焰风暴攻击目标区域内的所有单位，并额外持续造成烧灼伤害。
context.name: abyssal_underlord_firestorm

shard_loc.en: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.
shard_loc.zh: 火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。

context.description_en: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.
context.description_zh: 在目标区域制造致命的深渊；踏入深渊的敌方单位将受到伤害并且被缠绕。每个敌方单位每隔%pit_interval%秒才会再次受到作用。
context.name: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice

context.description_en: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
facet_text_en: Underlord's attacks cleave while he has bonus damage from Atrophy Aura.
facet_text_zh: 孽主在拥有衰退光环的攻击力加成时攻击具有分裂效果。
context.name: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
notes_en: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。

context.description_en: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.
context.description_zh: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得%dark_portal_multiplier%倍加成。
context.name: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss

context.description_en: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
context.description_zh: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法%warp_channel_duration%秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过%minimum_distance%。
facet_text_en: Underlord summons uncontrollable demonic Warriors and Archers after travelling through the Fiend's Gate that attack nearby enemies. These units deal %underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%% damage to buildings.
facet_text_zh: 孽主穿过恶魔之扉后会召唤不可控的恶魔战士和射手，攻击附近敌人。这些单位对建筑造成%underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%%伤害。
context.name: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
notes_en: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
notes_zh: 双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。

scepter_loc.en: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。

context.description_en: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
context.name: monkey_king_boundless_strike

shard_loc.en: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.
shard_loc.zh: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的%spring_channel_pct%%%。棒击大地设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

context.description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Tree Dance. Level %max_level% Tree Dance reduces the cooldown to zero.
facet_text_zh: 提升丛林之舞的最高等级。%max_level%级丛林之舞会把冷却时间降低至0。
context.name: monkey_king_tree_dance
notes_en: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

context.description_en: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下%charges%次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
context.name: monkey_king_jingu_mastery
notes_en: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

context.description_en: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣以周遭事物为启发进行伪装，改变自己的外形，从而欺骗对手。受到伤害，发动攻击或使用任意物品都会失去伪装效果。变化后%invul_duration%秒内免疫伤害。
context.name: monkey_king_mischief

context.description_en: Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的%attack_speed%秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
facet_text_en: Monkey King's soldiers last longer and do not disperse unless he spends more than %leadership_time_buffer% seconds outside the area.
Grants the Changing of the Guard ability during Wukong's Command.
facet_text_zh: 齐天大圣的猴子猴孙持续时间更长，而且离开圆阵后不会马上消散，除非他在圆阵外停留的时间超过%leadership_time_buffer%秒。
在猴子猴孙期间获得技能“出神入化”。
context.name: monkey_king_wukongs_command
notes_en: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
notes_zh: 猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。

scepter_loc.en: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
scepter_loc.zh: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。

context.description_en: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a %transfiguration_duration%s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，%transfiguration_duration%秒内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。变身后齐天大圣为无敌，但是无法攻击或施放技能。
context.name: monkey_king_transfiguration

context.description_en:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
context.name: pangolier_swashbuckle
notes_en: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.
notes_zh: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

context.description_en:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
facet_text_en: Pangolier can cast Shield Crash a second time mid-flight, dealing more damage and gaining more barrier. Longer flight time results in more damage and barrier increases.
facet_text_zh: 石鳞剑士可以在半空中再次施放甲盾冲击，造成更高的伤害，并获得更高数值的护盾。在空中的时间越久，伤害和护盾的数值越高。
context.name: pangolier_shield_crash

scepter_loc.en: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成%scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%%伤害。

context.description_en: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
context.description_zh: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。
context.name: pangolier_lucky_shot

context.description_en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
context.description_zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。
context.name: pangolier_rollup

context.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facet_text_en: Rolling Thunder movement and turn speed increased, but duration is decreased.
facet_text_zh: 地雷滚滚的移动和转身速度提升，但是持续时间减少。
context.name: pangolier_gyroshell
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

context.description_en: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
context.description_zh: 附近敌人攻击石鳞剑士时，他们触发物品和技能的随机类攻击特效的几率有所降低。
context.name: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
notes_en: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.
notes_zh: 对英雄技能和物品有效。
效果是特效发生的几率相对降低。

context.description_en: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: %initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
context.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
notes_en: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.
notes_zh: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。

context.description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
