context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
facet_text_en: While in Shadow Realm, Dark Willow emits a %aura_radius% radius aura that increases damage that she deals to enemies in its area of effect by up to %aura_damage_pct%%%. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm.
facet_text_zh: 处于暗影之境时，邪影芳灵会散发出一个%aura_radius%范围的光环，使她对范围内的敌人造成的伤害增加，最高为%aura_damage_pct%%%。根据她在暗影之境内停留的时间，造成的伤害会随之增加。
context.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
notes_en: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
notes_zh: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。

scepter_loc.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter_loc.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

context.description_en: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被眩晕。
facet_text_en: While ticking, Cursed Crown accumulates %accumulated_damage_pct%%% of all damage dealt by Dark Willow and %accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%% of attack damage dealt by allied heroes. When the counter ends, the accumulated damage is dealt again as magical damage to the whole area. This triggers even upon dispel with Aghanim's Shard.
facet_text_zh: 倒计时期间诅咒王冠会累计邪影芳灵对目标造成所有伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct%%%，还有友方英雄对其造成攻击伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%%。倒计时结束时，累计的伤害会作为魔法伤害施加给整个区域。拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后，可以在技能被驱散时触发。
context.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown

shard_loc.en: Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在%shard_spawn_radius%范围内产生%shard_bramble_amount%朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。

context.description_en: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。
context.name: dark_willow_bedlam

context.description_en: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵获得额外%hp_regen_amp%%%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至%hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%%。
context.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust

context.description_en: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
context.name: dark_willow_terrorize
notes_en: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.
notes_zh: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。

context.description_en: Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits. Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
context.description_zh: 天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
facet_text_en: Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.
facet_text_zh: 绝笔额外从另一只手发出对称的墨迹曲线。每个敌人只能受到一道墨迹的伤害，但是同时计入两道墨迹的额外伤害。
context.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry

context.description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
context.description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
context.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
notes_en: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

context.description_en: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
context.description_zh: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
facet_text_en: Ink Swell can be manually detonated early.
facet_text_zh: 墨涌可以手动提前引爆。
context.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk

shard_loc.en: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh: 墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。驱散类型：弱驱散

context.description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
context.description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
context.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait

context.description_en: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
context.description_zh: 将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
context.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
notes_en: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.
notes_zh: 如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。

context.description_en: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 天涯墨客的攻击和技能会使受作用的敌方英雄在身后留下一道墨痕，对天涯墨客造成的伤害减少，持续%debuff_duration%秒。
context.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
notes_en: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.
notes_zh: 获得作用下英雄的视野。
天涯墨客的幻象（包括暗绘）也拥有墨痕。

context.description_en: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
context.description_zh: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。
context.name: mars_spear
notes_en: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
notes_zh: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。

shard_loc.en: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
shard_loc.zh: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多%max_impale_targets%名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

context.description_en: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
context.description_zh: 玛尔斯举起他的战盾粉碎前方的敌人，将他们击退并且基于自身攻击力造成致命一击伤害。攻击英雄时攻击伤害提升。具有克敌机先效果。
context.name: mars_gods_rebuke
notes_en: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.
notes_zh: 神之谴戒的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

context.description_en: Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides. Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
context.description_zh: 每当玛尔斯受到来自正面或侧面的攻击时，他就挥舞他那面巨大的战盾来格挡一定百分比的伤害。可以开启，开启后获得相位移动状态，但无法攻击，自身锁定为面朝的方向，并且移动速度降低，但飞向队友的攻击弹道中%redirect_chance%%%将改变方向朝他飞去。
context.name: mars_bulwark
notes_en: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
notes_zh: 改向只会在弹道目标位于玛尔斯身后锥形区域内或他身边100范围内才会生效。
破坏会使正面和侧面减伤效果失效。

scepter_loc.en: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 开启护身甲盾后在玛尔斯的两侧共产生%soldier_count%名无敌的士兵。士兵会随着玛尔斯前进，继承全额攻击力和攻击特效并拥有攻击力加成，附带击退和减速效果。敌人在同一时间只会被1名士兵攻击。

context.description_en: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.
context.description_zh: %radius%范围内敌方英雄数量更多时，玛尔斯就会获得生命恢复，敌人数量越多，生命恢复也越高。
context.name: mars_dauntless

context.description_en: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
context.description_zh: 经过短暂的列队时间，玛尔斯召唤出环绕着战士的竞技场，战士们将阻挡敌人的攻击和动向。竞技场内的敌方英雄靠近边缘时将被战矛攻击，受到伤害并被击退。
facet_text_en: If Mars is in the Arena when an enemy dies inside of it, he restores %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of his max health and mana and gets a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%% attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. Allies inside the Arena receive %allied_reduction_pct%%% of the bonuses.
Arena of Blood obscures vision and enemies within the arena do not share vision with their allies.
facet_text_zh: 如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡时玛尔斯也在竞技场内，他会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得一个%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成效果，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。竞技场内的友军获得%allied_reduction_pct%%%加成效果。
热血竞技场会遮蔽视野，竞技场内的敌人不会与他们的友军共享视野。
context.name: mars_arena_of_blood

scepter_loc.en: Lowers cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%  of their max health and mana and get a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%  attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. This effect stacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间降低%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。这个效果可以叠加。

context.description_en: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵向目标地点派出一个残像。残像观察着一片区域，面朝矢量的方向。当有目标进入其视线，残像会拉扯，并造成伤害。
context.name: void_spirit_aether_remnant

shard_loc.en: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
shard_loc.zh: 额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

context.description_en: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵暂时遁入太虚，创造数个灵扉。穿过灵扉他能重组自身。穿出灵扉后，他对区域内所有敌人造成伤害。
facet_text_en: Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.
facet_text_zh: 退出异化时，距离虚无之灵最远的%aether_remnant_count%个灵扉处会产生残阴。如果在中央的灵扉重组则没有效果。残阴会面朝中央的灵扉，牵引时间和伤害降低。
context.name: void_spirit_dissimilate

context.description_en: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收量都会提升。
facet_text_en: Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.
facet_text_zh: 共鸣脉冲会产生更强的全伤害护盾，而不是物理伤害护盾。
context.name: void_spirit_resonant_pulse

scepter_loc.en: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 共鸣脉冲可以沉默敌人，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

context.description_en: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵从每点属性获得的攻击力提升%damage_stat_bonus_pct%%%，并且从力量中获得的生命恢复、敏捷中获得的攻击速度和智力中获得的魔法恢复提升%secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%%。
context.name: void_spirit_intrinsic_edge

context.description_en: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成%pop_damage_delay%秒减速，然后引爆。
context.name: void_spirit_astral_step
notes_en: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
notes_zh: 太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

context.description_en: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手开枪产生大范围的爆炸，对锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害和减速。平射距离内的伤害提升%point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%%，移动速度减缓、攻击速度降低和减速持续时间额外提升%point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%%。
facet_text_en: Scatterblast is narrower and longer. Bonus damage and slow when enemies are not in point blank range.
facet_text_zh: 电光石火更窄更长。对平射距离外的敌人造成额外伤害和减速。
context.name: snapfire_scatterblast

context.description_en: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
context.name: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
notes_en: The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.
notes_zh: 饼干的弹道速度为%projectile_speed%。

shard_loc.en: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.
shard_loc.zh: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，治疗目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个%shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

context.description_en: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手开动蜥蜴坐骑上的加农炮，快速发动%buffed_attacks%次固定伤害加上自身攻击伤害一定百分比的攻击。每次攻击都将削弱敌人的护甲。在持续时间内提供攻击距离加成。
context.name: snapfire_lil_shredder
notes_en: Sets base attack time to %base_attack_time%s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.
notes_zh: 持续时间内基础攻击间隔变为%base_attack_time%。
霹雳铁手的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

context.description_en: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to %max_time_in_belly% seconds.
context.description_zh: 小莫迪吞下一个小兵或一名友方英雄，再朝敌人吐出。单位停留在他肚子里最多可达%max_time_in_belly%秒。
context.name: snapfire_gobble_up
notes_en: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.
notes_zh: 电炎绝手在小兵被吐出并阵亡后获得相应的金钱。

context.description_en: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
context.description_zh: 小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和眩晕。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。
context.name: snapfire_spit_creep

context.description_en: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手的伙伴在%duration_tooltip%秒内喷吐出密集的火团。火团造成冲击伤害，在地面上产生炽烈的炎洼，可以使敌人减速并造成持续伤害。电炎绝手在持续时间内转身速率降低，并且具有最小喷吐距离，为%min_range%。点击右键可以选择火团的目标区域。
context.name: snapfire_mortimer_kisses
notes_en: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of %min_lob_travel_time% and maximum travel time of %max_lob_travel_time%.
notes_zh: 可以通过停止、停在原位或使用其他技能来终止。
最短飞行时间为%min_lob_travel_time%秒，最长飞行时间为%max_lob_travel_time%秒。

context.description_en: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。
context.name: snapfire_boomstick

context.description_en:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
context.description_zh:
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。
可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后会强制沿用该行为。
facet_text_en: If there are no bounce targets within range of Acorn Shot, it can bounce off a nearby tree and set the remaining number of bounces to %bounces_after_tree_bounce%.
facet_text_zh: 如果附近没有可弹射的目标，爆栗出击会弹射至附近的树木，剩余弹射次数将设为%bounces_after_tree_bounce%次。
context.name: hoodwink_acorn_shot
notes_en: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
notes_zh: 同一个目标可以被击中超过一次。
弹射会搜寻525范围内战争迷雾中的单位，但无视隐身单位。
种下的树持续20秒。

context.description_en: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
context.description_zh: 扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成眩晕。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
context.name: hoodwink_bushwhack
notes_en: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.
notes_zh: 若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。

context.description_en: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
context.description_zh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。
facet_text_en: Scurry also provides bonus attack and cast range.
facet_text_zh: 密林奔走还会提供攻击和施法距离加成。
context.name: hoodwink_scurry

context.description_en: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
context.description_zh: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。
context.name: hoodwink_decoy

context.description_en: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
context.description_zh: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。
context.name: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang

context.description_en:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
context.description_zh:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，%max_charge_time%秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在%misfire_time%秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退%recoil_distance%距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
facet_text_en: Sharpshooter has a %quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%% reduced cooldown. Damage, debuff duration, and wind-up times are reduced by %quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%. Turn rate is increased by %turn_rate_tooltip%%%.
facet_text_zh: 一箭穿心的冷却时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%%。伤害、负面状态持续时间和装载时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%。转身速率提升%turn_rate_tooltip%%%。
context.name: hoodwink_sharpshooter

scepter_loc.en: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。

context.description_en: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
context.description_zh: 森海飞霞有几率使敌人的攻击转向至附近的树木。
context.name: hoodwink_mistwoods_wayfarer
notes_en: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.
notes_zh: 受到转向攻击的树木会被摧毁。

context.description_en: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
context.description_zh: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
facet_text_en: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.
facet_text_zh: 在星破天惊结束后每次破晓辰星挥击和锤击敌方英雄都会使%movespeed_bonus_radius%范围内她和所有友军获得攻击速度加成，持续%movespeed_bonus_duration%秒。
context.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
notes_en: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.
notes_zh: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以%movement_speed%的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要%self_stun_duration%秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人%swipe_slow%%%移动速度，持续%sweep_stun_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
shard_loc.zh: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速%shard_movement_penalty%%%，移速最低为%movement_speed%。

context.description_en: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
context.description_zh: 破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留%pause_duration%秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
facet_text_en: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.
facet_text_zh: 上界重锤停在地面时，会产生天光现世的治疗和伤害效果，数值减少%hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%%，作用于重锤附近%hammer_solar_guardian_radius%范围。重锤的停留时间提升至%pause_duration%秒。
友方英雄在上界重锤的炽烈之径上行走会获得移动速度加成。
context.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
notes_en: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
notes_zh: 战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。

context.description_en: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
context.description_zh: 破晓辰星在数次攻击后提升了力量，她的下一次攻击会造成致命一击，并治疗她附近%heal_radius%范围内所有友方英雄，治疗量为攻击伤害的一定百分比。攻击小兵和野怪产生的治疗量有所减少。对友军的治疗量为%allied_healing_pct%%%。
facet_text_en: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
facet_text_zh: 只要破晓辰星击中目标时触发了熠熠生辉的强化攻击，她所有技能的冷却时间都会减少。
context.name: dawnbreaker_luminosity
notes_en: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 熠熠生辉的治疗效果可以通过生命回复增强效果获得提升。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

scepter_loc.en: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
scepter_loc.zh: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.

context.description_en: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
context.description_zh: 只要太阳出来，破晓辰星就会获得基础攻击力加成和额外视野，加成效果会在整个白天内逐渐降低。如果是破晓辰星制造的白天，在整个白天时间内加成效果始终是最大值。
context.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn

scepter_loc.en: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
scepter_loc.zh: 辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
context.name: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
notes_en: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
notes_zh: 脉冲间隔为%pulse_interval%秒。
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。

scepter_loc.en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
scepter_loc.zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。

context.description_en: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
context.description_zh: 玛西抓起一个友方或敌方目标，将其轻松地向她身后摔去，敌方目标将受到伤害并被减速。落地区域内所有敌方单位也会受到伤害并被减速。
context.name: marci_grapple

context.description_en:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
context.description_zh:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得%ally_movespeed_pct%%%移动速度加成，持续%ally_buff_duration%秒。
facet_text_en:
When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.

 Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.

 If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.
facet_text_zh:
回身踢设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）时，玛西会把目标友军带向她的最终目的地。友军落地时对敌人造成%ally_impact_damage_pct%%%回身踢伤害。

不会影响被缠绕或束缚的友军。

如果玛西已升级怒拳破，回身踢落地后玛西会获得一次%postjump_flurry_charges%拳的狂怒连技。如果怒拳破已经开启，则改为持续时间延长%postjump_unleash_duration%秒。

如果拥有阿哈利姆神杖，本次狂怒连技的脉冲效果不会沉默敌人。
context.name: marci_companion_run
notes_en: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
notes_zh: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
不会触发法术反弹。
多样施法时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。

shard_loc.en: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
shard_loc.zh: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。

context.description_en:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
context.description_zh:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的%max_partner_penalty%%%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的%shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%%会补充护盾。
facet_text_en: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.
facet_text_zh: 在护卫术效果下玛西和她的搭档会共享本技能%shared_healing_percent%%%的生命治疗量。
context.name: marci_bodyguard
notes_en: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
notes_zh: 玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。

context.description_en: Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
context.description_zh: 玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。所有友方信使被动获得%bonus_levels%级额外等级和%bonus_hp_tooltip%点额外生命。
context.name: marci_special_delivery
notes_en: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.
notes_zh: 特快专递的口哨具有%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇。
如果信使施放后没有移交任何物品，或还拥有物品，它都会停留在玛西身边。

context.description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
context.description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
context.name: marci_unleash
notes_en: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。驱散类型：弱驱散

context.description_en:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
context.description_zh:
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被眩晕。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。

可以随时使用停止指令来中止。
context.name: primal_beast_onslaught

context.description_en: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
context.description_zh: 獸践踏一切。每行进%step_distance%距离就会对獸附近范围内所有敌人造成伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上獸攻击力的一定系数。獸在技能期间被缴械。
facet_text_en: Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.
facet_text_zh: 踏启动后会使獸和他的友军获得移动速度加成。
context.name: primal_beast_trample

context.description_en:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
context.description_zh:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
context.name: primal_beast_uproar
notes_en: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

scepter_loc.en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter_loc.zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

context.description_en: Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location. Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
context.description_zh: 獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。
context.name: primal_beast_rock_throw

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续%channel_time%秒。
context.name: primal_beast_pulverize

context.description_en: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.
context.description_zh: 獸拥有%base_slow_resist%%%基础减速抗性，每拥有%hp_per_threshold%点生命上限就获得+%aoe_per_threshold%%%作用范围加成和+%slow_resistance_per_threshold%%%减速抗性。
context.name: primal_beast_colossal

context.description_en: Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
facet_text_en: Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 弹无虚发恐惧敌人后，神枪在手的触发几率提升至基础几率的%gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%倍，持续%gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%秒。
context.name: muerta_dead_shot
notes_en: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
notes_zh: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的%ricochet_distance_multiplier%倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。

scepter_loc.en: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
scepter_loc.zh: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。

context.description_en: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
context.description_zh: 召唤%num_revenants%个亡魂，缓慢地环绕目标地点。在区域内的敌人会被减速。亡魂会在敌人穿过时造成伤害和沉默。
facet_text_en: Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.
facet_text_zh: 唤魂内有敌方英雄阵亡会刷新持续时间，再产生一个亡魂，并且唤魂的作用范围扩大%kill_radius_expansion%。
context.name: muerta_the_calling

context.description_en: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
context.description_zh: 可以开关。开启后，琼英碧灵攻击时有几率对另一个目标再射一枪。
facet_text_en: Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown by %dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%s.
facet_text_zh: 神枪在手触发时，弹无虚发的剩余冷却时间减少%dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%秒。
context.name: muerta_gunslinger
notes_en: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
notes_zh: 如果距离内没有其他单位，她会向原目标发射两枪。
第二枪可以击中琼英碧灵攻击距离加上%target_search_bonus_range%范围内的单位。
第二枪可以触发攻击特效。
以英雄优先，然后是非英雄单位，然后是建筑。

context.description_en: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续%duration%秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。
context.name: muerta_spectral_slug

context.description_en: Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵变身，成为虚无状态，获得基础攻击力加成和相位移动状态。被动使总是可以攻击虚无状态下的目标，并且她在虚无状态下也能攻击。在她或目标处于虚无时，她的所有攻击伤害均为魔法伤害，她的物理吸血被视为技能吸血。驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: muerta_pierce_the_veil
notes_en: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
notes_zh: 琼英碧灵在变身期间可以躲避弹道。
琼英碧灵在变身后无法攻击建筑。

shard_loc.en: Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.
shard_loc.zh: 琼英碧灵在越界的持续时间内获得%spell_lifesteal%%%技能吸血。越界生效时每次击杀敌方英雄或有敌方英雄在附近阵亡时琼英碧灵都会永久获得%spell_amp_steal%%%技能增强。永久加成具有追溯效果。

context.description_en: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.
context.description_zh: 每当琼英碧灵附近%stack_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，她就会获得一层%spell_amp_per_stack%%%技能增强的叠加效果。琼英碧灵阵亡时，她会失去一半（向下取整）的叠加层数。
context.name: muerta_supernatural

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被恐惧，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和恐惧时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。
context.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts

context.description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
context.description_zh: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
context.name: ringmaster_the_box

scepter_loc.en: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

context.description_en: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
context.description_zh: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
context.name: ringmaster_impalement

context.description_en: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
context.description_zh: 百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
context.name: ringmaster_spotlight

context.description_en: Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速%aura_slow%%%。敌方英雄面对转轮超过%face_duration%秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在%trap_duration%秒后转轮会自动爆炸。
context.name: ringmaster_wheel

context.description_en: Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
context.description_zh: 只要百戏大王附近%souvenir_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。
facet_text_en: Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.
facet_text_zh: 百戏大王的纪念品是哈哈镜，强力水和整蛊垫。
百戏大王的纪念品是水晶球，独轮车和超重派。
context.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs

context.description_en: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
context.description_zh: 使用：比例失真制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
context.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
notes_zh: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

context.description_en: Use: Forcefully ImbibeTemporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.
context.description_zh: 使用：强力吸收暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为%strength_bonus_base% + %strength_bonus_per_level% * 百戏大王等级，持续%duration%秒。效果会维持%effect_strength_max_duration%秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。
context.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic

context.description_en: Use: WhoopsiePropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.
context.description_zh: 使用：噗把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。
context.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion

context.description_en: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
context.description_zh: 使用：上车召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。
context.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle

context.description_en: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
context.name: kez_echo_slash
notes_en: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.
notes_zh: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

context.description_en: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
context.description_zh: 凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。
context.name: kez_grappling_claw

context.description_en: Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
context.description_zh: 长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
context.name: kez_kazurai_katana

shard_loc.en: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.
shard_loc.zh: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血%lifesteal_pct%%%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。

context.description_en: Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
context.description_zh: 凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
context.name: kez_switch_weapons

scepter_loc.en: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.
scepter_loc.zh: 在使用流派变换后%scepter_cooldown_timer%秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。

context.description_en: Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
context.description_zh: 凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
context.name: kez_raptor_dance
notes_en: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.
notes_zh: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至%illusion_lifesteal_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
context.description_zh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。
context.name: kez_falcon_rush
notes_en: Does not work on buildings.
notes_zh: 不会对建筑生效。

context.description_en: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
context.description_zh: 凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成沉默。
context.name: kez_talon_toss
notes_en: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.
notes_zh: 固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

context.description_en: Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
context.description_zh: 装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
context.name: kez_shodo_sai

shard_loc.en: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
shard_loc.zh: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

context.description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
context.description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
facet_text_en: Increases Raven's Veil invisibility duration.
facet_text_zh: 提升渡鸦之纱的隐身时间。
context.name: kez_ravens_veil

context.description_en:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
context.name: largo_catchy_lick
notes_en: Can lick runes to pull them.
notes_zh: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

context.description_en: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
context.description_zh: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。
context.name: largo_frogstomp

context.description_en:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
context.description_zh:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
context.name: largo_croak_of_genius
notes_en: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.
notes_zh: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距%max_distance%以内时施加伤害。

context.description_en: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
context.description_zh: 朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。
context.name: largo_encore

shard_loc.en: Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.
shard_loc.zh: 只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。

context.description_en:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
context.description_zh:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被缴械，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
context.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
notes_en: Items can be used while in this mode.
notes_zh: 这个模式下可以使用物品。

special_values.heading_loc: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:
special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip

scepter_loc.en: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
scepter_loc.zh: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。

context.description_en: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
context.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
context.name: largo_song_fight_song

scepter_loc.en: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.
scepter_loc.zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。

context.description_en: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
context.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。
context.name: largo_song_double_time

context.description_en: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
context.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会治疗附近友方英雄。
context.name: largo_song_good_vibrations

abilities.description:
Stuns a target enemy unit for 1.6 seconds. 

Pierces Debuff Immunity.
abilities.title: Overwhelm

abilities.description: Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 120 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
abilities.title: Bash

context.lore: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into an enemy's soul.
context.notes:
The stun is melee range.
Does not stack with other bashes, and does not grant bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.
Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.

abilities.description: When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
abilities.title: Combo Breaker

context.lore: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.
context.notes: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

abilities.description: Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
abilities.title: Ability Upgrade

context.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

abilities.title: Ability Upgrade

context.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

name_zh: 阿哈利姆魔晶 - 消耗品
subject: aghanims_shard_roshan

abilities.description:
Gives +35 attack speed and +13% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds.

Radius: 1200
abilities.title: Endurance

abilities.description:
Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies. 

Radius: 1200
abilities.title: Swiftness Aura

context.lore: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

abilities.description: The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 250 additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by 30% for 4s.
abilities.title: Empower Spell

context.lore: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.
context.notes:
The slow debuff is dispellable.
The break debuff is not dispellable.

abilities.description:
Teleport to a target point up to 1400 units away. 

After teleportation, you restore 250 health and 100 mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
abilities.title: Arcane Blink

context.lore: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.
context.notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

abilities.description:
Restores 150 mana to all nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
abilities.title: Replenish

abilities.description:
Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies. 

Radius: 1200
abilities.title: Basilius Aura

hint: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
context.lore: Magi equipped with these boots are valued in battle.
context.notes: Does not work on Meepo clones.

abilities.description:
When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

 You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.
abilities.title: Unholy Strength

context.lore: Weapon of choice among brutes, the bearer sacrifices his life energy to gain immense strength and power.
context.notes:
The strength change will affect both maximum and current HP, but you cannot die from the change.
The strength change occurs over 0.6 seconds.
Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.

abilities.description:
Grants 30 attack speed and 5 armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by -5.

Radius: 1200
abilities.title: Assault Aura

context.lore: Forged in the depths of the nether reaches, this hellish mail provides an army with increased armor and attack speed.

abilities.description: Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
abilities.title: Bash

context.lore: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.
context.notes:
Does not stack with other sources of Bash.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.
Does not grant Bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.

context.lore: A valued accessory for improving vitality.

abilities.description: Destroy a target tree.
abilities.title: Chop Tree

abilities.description: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged.
abilities.title: Quell

abilities.description: Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)
abilities.title: Cleave

context.lore: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.
context.notes:
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.

abilities.description:
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. 

Duration: 9s 
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
abilities.title: Avatar

context.lore: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.
context.notes:
Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

abilities.description: For 5.5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.
abilities.title: Damage Return

abilities.description: Everytime you are attacked, you return 10 damage plus 15% of the attack damage dealt to you.
abilities.title: Damage Return

context.lore: A razor-sharp coat of mail, it is the choice of selfless martyrs in combat.
context.notes:
Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
